I didn’t make this decision lightly.
#

---
Katie Porter here with exciting news, **I’m running to be California’s next governor.**
**More below, but first, can you split a donation of $10 between State Democrats Committee and our campaign to become a founding donor today?**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/86957?refcode=em20250312-8816&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8816%2E614464%2Ed00T0c)**
Peter, I didn’t make this decision lightly. But with an emboldened Trump in the White House and MAGA loyalists doing his bidding day in and day out, California—and our country—need a leader who is ready to go toe to toe with extremists.
I first ran for office in 2018. I was a single mom of three little kids, running in a district that Republicans had held for decades. **But I ran because I couldn’t sit on the sidelines as I watched Trump try and destroy our country.** As a consumer protection attorney, I wanted to use my experience to hold him and his administration accountable.
With the support of folks like you, I made it to Congress, where I was able to claw back billions from drug companies who ripped us off and pass laws cracking down on health care companies that wrongfully denied care.
**I feel the same call to serve today as I did during Trump’s first administration.**

body:
When then Attorney General Kamala Harris appointed me to be California’s watchdog over the Big Banks during the foreclosure crisis
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39533%2E3422442%2EHraZ6O)
Hey Derek,
If you’ve got three minutes, I want to share a bit about the kind of governor I’ll be.
When then Attorney General Kamala Harris appointed me to be California’s watchdog over the Big Banks during the foreclosure crisis, I didn’t have much formal power. I had a shoestring budget and a single part-time staffer.
**But, I also had a commitment to doing right by Californians and the spirit to never give up.** Through hard work and perseverance, we were able to recover billions of dollars to help families get back on their feet.
When I launched my first-ever political campaign after Donald Trump’s election in 2016, pundits didn’t believe we could win. It was a historically Republican area that no Democrat had ever represented in 70+ years.
I didn’t listen to the naysayers. We built a team of staff and volunteers, spoke to thousands and thousands of voters, and ultimately flipped the seat from red to blue.
**As California’s next governor, I’m not going to be complacent while MAGA Republicans attack our rights or while our cost-of-living crisis stretches families even thinner.** I’m going to get to work and bring everyone to the table to solve our state’s biggest challenges.
**[I’ve never been afraid of hard work, but I can’t run a winning campaign alone. Can I count on your support?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250312_4_ak?refcode=em20250312-39533&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39533_3422442_HraZ6O&akid=39533%2E3422442%2EHraZ6O)**

Thanks for being part of this movement,
Katie

March 12, 2025
Under the Biden administration, many elite universities were convulsed with violence and antisemitism when Israel invaded the Gaza Strip. Israel retaliated to a terrorist attack by Hamas that resulted in over 1,200 deaths, multiple rapes and the taking of over two hundred hostages.
Thus far, the Trump administration has only punished Columbia University, cancelling the Biden administration's $400,000,000 grant. Columbia has a $14.8 billion endowment.
And Columbia deserved it.
According to the [ADL](https://substack.com/redirect/8f64df97-f7d4-4585-a12e-3003829443bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (Anti-Defamation League - an organization fighting antisemitism):
"During the fall of 2023, incidents of swastika vandalism, physical assaults, and the posting of stickers reading "Zionist Donors and Trustees Hands Off Our University," and "Zionism is Terrorism" were reported on campus. Visibly Jewish students have reported being spat on and subjected to antisemitic rhetoric including "F*** the Jews." In October 2023, an Israeli student was allegedly beaten on his hand with a stick outside of the University library after confronting a perpetrator for ripping down flyers of Israeli hostages held by Hamas."
The response by Columbia's administration could be charitably called tepid. Emboldened, anti-Israel protesters occupied that campus quad and then took over and vandalized a building. This was all on videotape but the Manhattan District Attorney - who found six weeks of time to convict Donald Trump for allegedly copulating with a porn star over twenty years ago and using creative bookkeeping to cover it up - looked the other way.
Which brings us to Yale. While Yale purports to allow free speech, this is selectively enforced. Sympathizers of the Palestinian cause can express their opinions, but Jewish professors and students are harassed for doing the same.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/860e08b9-156a-4ee0-bff1-87c540dacf21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Anti-Israeli protestors at Yale graduation ceremony
Consider the following:
Azmi Ahmad, a medical researcher blocked an Israeli postdoc student from commenting on a film about the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. When another professor, Evan Morris, [wrote an article exposing this](https://substack.com/redirect/255a019a-369c-4ae8-b701-2a02b814af2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), he was [investigated by Yale's committees](https://substack.com/redirect/155e6589-39e8-4b7a-aecb-5bfee09b399c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for months.
Yale took no action against Professor Zareena Grewal after she honored October 7 [the day of the Hamas massacre of Israelis] as "an extraordinary day."
The Yale Women's Center [hosted events](https://substack.com/redirect/8cd880fa-46d4-4ec1-b5cd-e5c58fce8083?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) highlighting supposed Israeli atrocities against the Palestinians but when a Jewish student wished to present a different viewpoint, she was denied.
Perhaps the Yale administrators believed such a biased approach would decrease the possibility of violence, as those who sympathize with Israel tend to be less violent than those who do not.
It didn't work out.
Pro-Palestinian students and professors [occupied the college quad](https://substack.com/redirect/9caa3661-b2f9-43ae-a7cc-881049bedffe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) overnight (a violation of campus policy), spewed antisemitic hatred, tore down the American flag and assualted a Jewish student who had the guts to confront them.
While some efforts were made to discipline the protestors, none suffered significant consequences for their action.
The Trump administration is now perusing the films of this occupation and may find cause to deport participating foreign students who are violating our laws. Already the Trump administration is trying to deport one of the ring leaders of the Columbia protests, Syrian national Mahmood Khalil.

A Yale Law School graduate and Obama-appointed judge, Jesse Furman, has temporarily blocked his deportation. But [according to American law,](https://substack.com/redirect/bf5d65ea-f567-4fd1-b169-056d1b79da91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Khalil - even though he is a permanent resident alien - can be deported if he promotes a government-declared terrorist organization, which he clearly did. Stay tuned.
But as an interesting aside: What would happen to an American student studying in Syria who led a pro-Israel protest?
President Trump should block all federal funding of Yale. After all, Yale's endowment is over $40 billion. They won't miss it.
Meanwhile, liberals appalled by antisemitism must speak out. Their strategy to remain silent during the Presidential election out of fear of upsetting the fragile coalition needed elect Kamala Harris failed.
Donald Trump is now President and liberals appalled by antisemitism should now have the courage to support his agenda on this issue, even if they are repulsed by him otherwise.

And to that, I say **absolutely.** Friend, my name is Winsome Earle-Sears. I don't often make promises, but I can promise you this: I'm not your typical politician, **and I 'm not like the others who normally send you these messages:**-I immigrated to the US from Jamaica with my family when I was six years old.
-I served in the Marine Corps as an electrician.
-I ran a women's homeless shelter and a men's prison ministry.I've lived a full, rewarding life - and I owe it all to this country. In a world of so much uncertainty, I know one thing to be 100% true: _**my story is only possible in America.**_ And now, I'm running for Governor of Virginia - to make certain that the same country that let a poor, black woman ascend to the highest levels of politics remains that way - a beacon of hope.

_But the reality we have to confront is that those on the Left are actively trying to tear this down. ### A conundrum, and a succinct poem depicting America in 2025

Having spent the last 20 years working to expose bipartisan corruption in Washington, I've observed the last few months in politics with a confounding mix of feelings. On the one hand, it's satisfying to see my warnings revealed as more prescient than I wish. It's also a relief to watch the Democratic Party effectively collapse in public, given [how much responsibility it shares](https://substack.com/redirect/b2f955bb-692d-45a1-80dc-63e5a99dc85c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for everything from [human rights abuses en masse](https://substack.com/redirect/312f60f5-a58b-4cc2-b48f-6324766e5df0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to wars for profit & plunder, to [Trump's return to the White House](https://substack.com/redirect/915f9979-c7b6-4f53-ae12-d9da648ccc75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Of course, realizing the misery to which the future has been consigned prompts some measure of frustration and fear. On the other hand, I'm thankful to have never dragged children into this world, and confident that I won't live beyond another 50 years, so I've been equally grateful to largely step aside and let others--particularly the careerists and apparatchiks who I once tried to hold accountable--grapple with the inevitable consequences of their regrettable ignorance.
_Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! This post is public so feel free to share it._

### **Where does one even start?**
In the past few weeks, I've started posts exploring:
* the mounting global climate catastrophe;
* escalating attacks on free speech by an administration & supporting grassroots movement that falsely claim to respect it;
* the detention of a Palestinian-American student organizer, and what it portends for the "freedoms" that Americans pretend they enjoy;
* the long overdue recognition by Europe of the belligerence that has long defined U.S. foreign policy;
* political violence within the U.S. and its implications for its claims to represent democracy;
* a novel analysis of the Supreme Court's 2015 _Obergefell v. Hodges_ decision and its ultimate impact on LGBTQ communities; and
* the complicity of a Democratic state governor bending public policy to appease the financial interests of the world's richest man.

Every one of these posts remains in a draft form, largely because each news cycle has delivered its own outrages overwhelming my capacity to address them all thoughtfully. Some have described this phenomenon as a consequence of leaders "[flooding the zone](https://substack.com/redirect/abbce23d-29ec-46f4-8947-214e7542898b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," inspired by the tactics of authoritarians in the past.
Usually, contemporary references to "flooding the zone" reflect on the institutional incapacity of the press to keep up with the pace of current events, and the constant noise of our president's governance-by-stream-of-consciousness.
For me, it also presents unique challenges. First, leaving my career in law and politics to become a sports instructor left me with much less time at a computer. While I once enjoyed the luxury of focusing my time on advocacy and activism, I now work primarily outdoors for a living and have struggled to schedule adequate time for research and writing. In addition, my goals and role as a writer have shifted over the last few years.
There was a time when I wrote to inform the public, and correct misinformation spread by journalists enabling the military-industrial fascism that has defined the U.S. for generations. I worked for decades to defend and cultivate democracy, organizing grassroots campaigns from Connecticut to California and recruiting allies to challenge the [bipartisan consensus in Washington enabling fascism](https://substack.com/redirect/b2f955bb-692d-45a1-80dc-63e5a99dc85c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I imagined that readers might be able to do something once armed with information.
I've discovered since then that, [as Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. once observed](https://substack.com/redirect/fa6da4d7-1573-43e0-aeeb-9b7d6f897b98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Americans prefer comfort, convenience, and are willing to embrace outright and obvious lies rather than value accuracy, insight, or even their own rights. The complicity of so many voices who for decades have enabled [America's predatory class of millionaire and billionaire politicians](https://substack.com/redirect/d25d99dd-b14d-44ce-8950-02576bd8c894?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (on both sides of the partisan aisle) has forced me to reconsider my goals as a writer.
### **Recalling my roots**
I'll keep writing about law, politics, history, culture, and grassroots resistance to fascism in America. [Explaining](https://substack.com/redirect/4c98c5a5-0956-47e8-bcc7-93206d084b2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) what others seem to [widely](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd6aa02-3d14-4d71-933a-6dbc8776f365?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) overlook, and [highlighting marginalized voices](https://substack.com/redirect/6565fa56-5159-40c0-96a0-558072a57204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [resistance](https://substack.com/redirect/69c5f78f-bd36-4a35-a66d-4cf546c10904?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to American imperialism, has given me a sense of intellectual purpose--even if it feels politically futile.
But struggling to define my goals as a writer led me back to where I began, long before ever studying law and discovering my calling as a public advocate and defender of the future.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8a2afae8-d630-40d3-9b12-31cd27ac1d25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even before the socialist manifestos that I wrote during high school in the 80s, my earliest writing included poetry and song lyrics. I've never stopped writing in those formats, but have often marginalized them relative to my prose, perhaps reflecting a bias that I internalized growing up with parents who wanted me to enjoy the financial security that comes with more conventional choices.
Yet my first appearances as a public speaker were in the context of hip-hop and spoken word poetry. While my writing & public speaking about law and politics eventually came to reach a far broader audience, it was [poetry](https://substack.com/redirect/8450f171-e9cf-47ba-95a4-53f33b58baf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that gave me my voice, [my mode of grassroots organizing](https://substack.com/redirect/7e908ac7-31fe-43ee-85d4-a6229d46f919?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and brought me the inspiration to seek a broader audience in the first place.
I wrote this poem nearly two years ago, on April 9, 2023. At the time, I thought of it as a tongue-in-cheek reflection on the climate disaster and how it will inevitably come home for all of us.
The most compelling art, however, has a life of its own well beyond the vision of its creator. And in the wake of the past few weeks, I have come to see this poem through the lens of an allegory depicting the political news cycle.
### **Storms**
Every weather feature
that unfortunately falls over
any factory farm
flings foul
feces phenomenally
far and wide
_Paid subscribers can access a longer poem that I 've performed across the country since sometime around 2004. I wrote it as a public service announcement for the D.C. Guerrilla Poetry Insurgency recruiting other artists to raise their voices..._

clean_body: | | | My situation is in your hands, Peter. I'm writing today to give you an update and to make a humble plea. Look - this is from the bottom of my heart, so please read this message to the end. My team and I put together a historic win in 2021 to help flip all three of Virginia's highest offices red. Ever since becoming Lt. Governor, I've been logging big wins for my friends, neighbors, and every fellow Virginian. Now, I'm running for Governor so we can continue to keep up the amazing work we've been doing here in the Commonwealth and make history again. But right now I have a few SERIOUS challenges: I was legally barred from accepting even a dime in support of my campaign while I was in the Virginia legislative session. But my Democrat opponent, Abigail Spanberger, was fundraising BIG TIME while I was working hard in our capital. Seriously , a far-Left group injected $500K into Abigail Spanberger 's campaign coffers and there wasn't a thing I could do in response! Now Spanberger has an ENORMOUS fundraising advantage, Peter. Polls show this race is tied, but Spanberger has a serious cash advantage.If we don 't make up the difference, our conservative mission will be cut short. Today, I 'm making a plea to you as a Christian, a mother, and a Marine; please send in any amount you can spare to support my campaign! | | Without your support, we will fall even further behind. The Democrat elitists will log a win and our Commonwealth will regress down a path to irreversible socialism!I wouldn't ask you to stay in this fight if I didn't think it was worth it. And Peter, I know we will win if we hold strong and fight this battle together. I am asking you from the bottom of my heart; please stick with me and help us keep the conservative movement thriving! Ever Forward,Lt. Governor Winsome Sears Immigrant Marine First black female Lt. Governor of VA | Immigrant. Marine. Mom. Small Business Owner. Lieutenant Governor.I'm Winsome Sears, and I've held many titles in my life. Each one hasn't been a cakewalk, but I like a challenge. I've tried to show my daughters that what you can accomplish is not decided by the color of your skin or where you were born.Sure, a silver spoon would've made it easier, but I've found a helping hand from your community means so much more. This will be another challenge, but with you on my side, I know I can do this. | | | Paid for by Winsome for Governor Military disclaimer: Neither military info nor photographs of Winsome Sears in uniform imply endorsement of Winsome Sears by the Department of Defense or its particular military departments. ### **I applied for a film grant from Vimeo, Red, and Nikon**
---
**Funding Proposal for Vimeo Short Film Grant | Presented by Nikon | RED****The funds awarded by the Vimeo Short Film Grant would be essential in elevating** _**Frozen Odds: The Game of Alaska's Election**_**to a professional standard that captures the complexity and emotional depth of Alaska's 2022 election. While I have invested in key equipment such as the RED Scarlet-W, RED Komodo 6K, and high-quality audio gear, additional resources are crucial to enhance production value and effectively convey the film's message.****Grant funds would be allocated as follows:**
1. **Travel & Location Shoots: Capturing Alaska’s vast and remote landscapes is critical to visually telling this story. Funds would support travel to key locations such as Anchorage, Fairbanks, and smaller rural communities where the impact of the election was deeply felt.**
2. **Cinematography & Visual Effects: To illustrate complex voting mechanics like Ranked Choice Voting, funds would enable the creation of clear, animated visual explanations that simplify the process for viewers. This is vital for ensuring the film is accessible to all audiences.**
3. **Post-Production & Editing: Funds will allow me to secure a professional colorist and sound designer to refine the final product, ensuring consistency in visual tone and immersive audio quality.**
4. **Interviews & Expert Commentary: The grant will support travel and technical costs for conducting interviews with election officials, political experts, and grassroots campaigners whose insights are crucial to telling this story.**

**With this support, I can create a powerful, visually striking documentary that reveals the challenges of Alaska’s 2022 election and explores what this experience means for democracy across America.**
---
#### **Frozen Odds -**
**Alaska — vast, untamed, and unpredictable. Beneath its snow-covered peaks and icy rivers lies a political battlefield unlike any other. This is the story they didn’t want you to know.****Powerful names — Lisa Murkowski, Hansjörg Wyss, Arabella Advisors, and George Soros — echo through the corridors of influence, shaping the future of the Last Frontier. |

---
| | [CLICK HERE AND PRINT OFF THE PETITON ](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016zgpSXh4VIGQRbhRyBfdHF9O0JsfM8ZLVzO2k_hFSfPgNAKAX3tiGGjMqiSZjllpbksUqe48y49ws2TsU9cFI1q94L7Ja_0lph8ywj2OAi9tjVrh9guRzqxxQKs8lFzdNf_KbSjoVXeGNSlxf04gh2waizQr0PbY&c=ByF-cDZVHU8LY0qKsRLhy-dpLprzebGSWQbobygcavKu6XDBqCueHQ==&ch=rBwm81qTP6oiFBAe3PoOlUbLJCNallOJyoXQ39sd7Chsau5xt5O_aQ==)

|
Dear Hello Many of you have pleaded with me to run for governor and promised to vote for me. However, in order for my name to appear on the ballot, we have to collect the necessary signatures to get my name on the ballot.
We must collect 10,000 valid signatures, 400 in each Congressional District, and as a campaign, turn the signatures into the State Board of Elections before Thursday, April 3 at 5pm.
We would like to receive all forms before Monday, March 31, so that we can properly organize and vet the signatures before turning them in to the Virginia State Board of Elections.
Hundreds of you have reached out and are actively collecting signatures. Thank you. It's only through your efforts that my name will appear on the ballot. Currently, our campaign is 100 percent run by volunteers in each locality. We have no paid staff. The amazing organization you've seen from my campaign is all run by volunteers who want an American First Governor, who can beat Abigail Spanberger in November.
If 500 people collect just 2 pages or 24 signatures, we meet our goal. Will you commit to helping?
Thanks to many of you who have already answered that call. If everyone does their part, you will be able to vote for me in June. If not, you won't have a choice.
The response has been so tremendous that I believe we can do this. But you must follow through. We do have grassroots across the state who have accepted the challenge. But is it enough?
Will you trust that someone else is going to do the work or are you going to take the bull by the horns and take ownership of making sure I get on the ballot?
We have less than 3 weeks to go until our deadline, and we've made tremendous progress.
We have a team of grassroots volunteers in every Congressional District across the state actively collecting signatures. To join a team in your area, please reply to this email and I will personally connect you with volunteers in your area.
Remember. I said yes, but only if you help me.
In order for you to vote for me on June 17, please print off the attached petition and collect the signatures of your family, friends and neighbors, so that I can get on the ballot.
WE CANNOT COLLECT SIGNATURES ONLINE.
Signatures must be witnessed in person by signing an old fashioned paper petition ballot.
Are you ready to say yes? Here's what you need to do:

1. Print off the attached form on one sheet of paper, front and back.
2. Witness your friends, family and neighbors sign the petition form. Please make sure they actually sign the form. Please also make sure their writing is legible so that signatures can be verified.
3. Keep in mind that you can't sign your own petition form.
4. Please collect signatures by[ Congressional District.](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016zgpSXh4VIGQRbhRyBfdHF9O0JsfM8ZLVzO2k_hFSfPgNAKAX3tiGFr1zr2O8s5wmB8GfkST-rJO9rjsnXq6IA-IXgrcaEDZfpUcPGNdc3C-Y9yqVeGJrLtoWZgPtAvckHER_w9Dv6pChtnM6DKQF0oMQYwETXSH1WXGUtlthihMZ0IaGl8Fgm5kl8iETNlig2VHIRkbmRo=&c=ByF-cDZVHU8LY0qKsRLhy-dpLprzebGSWQbobygcavKu6XDBqCueHQ==&ch=rBwm81qTP6oiFBAe3PoOlUbLJCNallOJyoXQ39sd7Chsau5xt5O_aQ==) One Congressional District per form. You can write the Congressional District in the upper right hand corner.
5. Get the petition notarized at your local bank for free.
6. Drop the petition off in person to: 2023 Church Street, Appomattox, VA 24522
7. Or Fed Ex the petition to:

Friends of Amanda Chase 2023 Church Street #250 Appomattox, VA 24522
For security reasons we will not publish a public calendar, but you can call us at 804 370 8727 or email me at amanda@chaseforva.com to find out when we will be in your area and to coordinate picking up your petitions with the volunteer coordinator in your area.
---
| Please use the link below to print off the petition forms.
Please remember the forms must be double sided and printed front and back. You must also witness every signature and visit your local bank to have a notary sign off on your petition form before mailing.
Please note that we need the original copy. Photocopies are not allowed.
If you have any questions please email Craig at craig@chaseforva.com or call 804 370 8727. If you have trouble printing the forms, we can mail you the forms.
I can do this with your help. Please print off a petition now. Don't wait. Get your immediate family to sign the petition and then get your friends at church and work to sign your petition. Time is not on our side. Less than 19 days to collect signatures.
If not you, then who?
Please click the button below to print your petitions today and start collecting signatures as you run your errands throughout your day.

| | **Chip Roy here.** **I 've got a bill that will shake the Uniparty to its core.** **Later on, I 'm hoping supporters like you will get in on the action.** But first, I want to say thank you. _Thank you for going through HELL and BACK with me_. Whether it was the speaker showdowns... The budget battles... Or cutting off the spending spigot**HOSING DOWN** the American taxpayer... You've stood by me every step of the way. **_And it 's _**_**_PAID OFF_**_** _._** House Republicans finally came to their senses - passing a budget that _cuts TRILLIONS in government spending_. But now is not the time to fade off into the sunset... _Now is the time to STRIKE while the IRON IS HOT_. **That 's why I'm reintroducing a bill that will DELIVER A FINAL KNOCK-OUT BLOW to the Uniparty: ** **_Banning all members of Congress from engaging in insider stock trading. _** For YEARS, we've seen career politicians RIG policy decisions so they can cash in on millions. Washington D.C. is NOT a place meant for politicians to get rich. _Especially when Americans like you are left holding the bag_. But here's the good news: **THE GIG IS UP!** President Trump and DOGE blew the lid off of Washington's schemes. Momentum is on OUR side and _Americans like you are in the driver 's seat_. **It 's high time we ban insider stock trading in Congress and kick dirty politics to the curb...FOR GOOD!** But I need your continued support. I'm going to get **MAJOR BLOWBACK** for this bill. All of the millions being made in Washington off of this exact type of corruption will be _funneled right back into taking down my campaign_. And not just from said Democrats or Republicans... _**_But from the entire UNIPARTY_**_** _._** The American people are the ONLY FORCE strong enough to **PLOW THROUGH WASHINGTON 'S ATTACKS. ** While I'm ramming through this bill, will you keep my campaign fighting strong? I'm blessed with your support.

## Severe Storm Looms for U.S.
A [powerful storm is set to sweep across the U.S.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQhX8N3oiOszHOwNDFW7p2tC7mHGixiYDGSn59lVbt1u1JT_r03vd2mk4UYtgur7SyrUuaEFBLaKVqJ0ch3qeucXZhRm4btsp0augBemi8nbvBKD4avSApzagHxGHAmQw7x3Bugn3SoFWtAgDdH6AFtahjP2ujjVMkOmAXasqH9xS26nmJ93TjfJjT2kTra70W0b4IHAWOO1P1P53AcUmZZypV4LhRDWmj-Iy8F4Hj3wmQhW-cWabPes5MH_Icw-NB2UkfLl7uYXNF_rLkSnn2stSU1yZbd91DjKH0RnRwWSnE7131P083i18BAAD__8WfarM) today through Sunday, bringing heavy rain, snow, and severe weather from California to the East Coast. In [Southern California](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAQRp8Gd0TDj41dUNzGXW67pTXGg80KQwTEUd5-le23_PRJR0fn677cMcSQ9v94km0-LxJkz0FxoZYNQ3wvutusJ5KkOrLCaDEOAAN0hwW_eaf9tI6jWY2cQBNO_aB0j8bhqrtgPzRQQgkA6IcbKBBeTIPrTW82gUwDbaHlcvvOIbWDfHzni8rN5bOL9mjtUZn6x-TM5IyrM5-DyTmGi_jzsWGj-pm5ckw7Raq8YEicLnRPbCEn_sKSQtorJ-_JNV5bLic_80WV1_xsB5XEHcbgc0kBmZzFAELCqJmcu2K3xyvEGOpgmIb9xBB_5dpfsS4rfwIAAP__qztswQ), evacuation warnings are in effect for several burn scar areas as officials brace for potential mudslides, flooding, and debris flows, with the heaviest rain expected tonight into Thursday. Blizzard conditions are likely in parts of the Plains on Thursday and Friday, while severe [thunderstorms and possible tornadoes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DGv3CAQBOBfY3drLWDwuaBIc91Lm9LimeWxCTYnIId8vz66pE77jTQazY-P7cNx4vPruzvItpA3iVIDKhBq847Ttc2jt4FIkhrJimUWN4NocIx2DeKGwaGn3ehAn3r32ugbumU3i5z3ke27DZVQAhG1mVChCGI1u1704oUbZiTPLZfpZ-azRQrpyk8q056PMdnY2qMO6tsg74O8996ny8Wc3-kg7yf1-mY-GxWoLZcDWobuUsoP-F2hRa7QiX5B5xYhknteUByf8Jn49XLFV3CnhxYLuQY5QMvldD7TP--cfOBCFYSRSuG6LlNsRxqL9Y_OKXE1yzDj1-E4_Z3c_nfh08o_AQAA__9VcXXx) threaten the Midwest and Southeast heading into the weekend. Forecasters also warn of extreme wildfire risk in the Southwest through Friday due to high winds and dry conditions.
## Inflation Dips to 2.8% in February
[Inflation eased to 2.8% in February](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1uxCAQBOCnwZ2tZTH-KSjS0F3alBYHy3kjbCyOnHVvHzl96hl9I83Xbbk5Trw_Pt1Gpsa8IKBuQbVSLcFxei99E0wkQlINGTn2choABmhWM-n7PI6ktEQC6Xo9TTQPbpp8CGF2oWFzaaCkkgCghw4UyCjnwetRj0E60QMFrrl035n3ulJM7_yi0vm8NcmstR5PoT4EWoH2PM_O73d_hQLtRQu0oARaiQKtP7jlPSZXOe9toSOX2ka6lx9X3u1V79a6paaYcJycEj-HUfTw2Bynv8H63wEvg78BAAD__4h0Wog), down from 3% in January and lower than analysts expected, as prices for groceries, gasoline, and housing moderated, the government reported Wednesday. The biggest price increase came from egg prices, which surged 59% over the past year due to avian flu outbreaks and supply issues, while shelter costs rose 4.2%, the lowest since 2021. Core inflation, which excludes food and energy, rose 3.1%—the lowest in nearly four years. [See a chart here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L9uwyAYBPCnwRvWB9iQDAxd2NK1o8Wfj0CLISI0Vt6-SvbOJ_10d1-X7WJzyfX6aXfUI7aNA18pCMrEFmwuz22Zgo6IHMWEmqmFnSSAhCnpBUGh84uy3p4hnvyKykXmpPXBOyGnrF8aCCYYAKxyBgEssrP0q1pVYJYsgCGP1ufvlutIGMuzPbDPvu1T0WmM252ID8IN4eY4jtlX518h4eZFE25AEG4YJ9wk7HinIyHNNRY7cqvUdbQ_oR2VxtZpRNd_bX_S98hcaatIfbJ9zGnsZeo63I5cSr5LRRa47jaXd5Xx3zUPzf8CAAD__4nnZRw).
## 132-Year-Old Lake Superior Shipwreck Found
Explorers have found the [wreck of the _Western Reserve_](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAUBp8GOqzDj7FTUNzGXW67pYXNIWaDjQUkKG-_8vbbfdInzUjzdZ_vNsRwPP7bHU31aRYgegaScTk7G-JnVtQZjyhQUjR8UHzUABroZhY7CvC818qJxTsvRyv1TcG4DmqxiDSYiwaSSw4Ave5AAvf8ptd-6AfHLVGALtSUu-8Ujrqhj5_0xtytaafRbLWehch_RExETK21bl3Kga1cPxHTNYmYyhbOlnF9slLR7phZw1IxHyxjwfxG5tPrcCzaJ7LyOjGHlImYaDbubCHGUPRAFDx2G-Kvuv6V4m3ETwAAAP__MHxiaQ), a 300-foot all-steel freighter that sank in Lake Superior 132 years ago, killing 27 people. The Great Lakes Shipwreck Historical Society discovered the ship, broken in two and resting 600 feet underwater, after a two-year search using sonar and a remotely operated vehicle. [See a video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z8GOgyAUheGngV3NvVwBXbCYpHExSbvt0qBAZYKlsVTHt584-27PSb7kv136i40pPu5XO3tTQu4FCHkCOiH1zsa09zV3JngvPHFvUNfYKAAFfDJyaNGhHZVVQehWNcFK1QyN0BKJUPJoDg0ICQFAqgoIMGCrRqmldmhZDd7FkpfqJ8dHmXxIe179Uo155slMpTxfjL6Y6Jjotm2r9vwu78Ef_7HYMk6MupXR-VyW23daxutvzRfjnltMKb6UZjXcZxvTP1k-Ja5G_AUAAP__kaVRbg). Known as "the inland greyhound," the ship was hailed for its speed and safety but split apart during a storm in 1892—a tragedy recounted by [its lone survivor](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD3T2yAQhH8N6vAcB_pwoSIN3Zs2pediDuvyYuEBbEb_PqP0qbZ5Zp_Z_fV1-yJJsj9-0pPXFvMNAUcNVht7CyTpuLkhrJEZ2Q68mtmZZQKYYNhWXtCAI2fGxdASyUWeryOgnVy4GhsGWc82sMYaABinC1gw0Vyn-ziPczCkHHCQlsvlT5a9bRzTkT9cLvf8HNK6tfaqyv5Q6BX63vvlXanlQMcJKPS15XIo9Dv3egY1ybtCf2oVerAKvTEK_SYnKnddN3n1wvdv3bk2LrsuXLl8WMf83oOWXT8KU9OJvrnq-n5xkVx036RxlLrp33Roio2LNhb1wVRO9YLoYIQJYFboh7KGV5eUpE6zcvB4kqR_o9r_Tv6s-DcAAP__xSp9BQ). Explorers say the _Western Reserve_ will remain on the lakebed, preserved by the lake’s cold water, for further study.

body:

---
| | | | | Friend, [**Add your name, and tell CBS to fight Trump’s baseless lawsuit >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb61514ba-89f0-41ac-9597-20501c66092b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Last year, before becoming president, Donald Trump sued CBS claiming that 60 Minutes edited their interview with Kamala Harris to unfairly influence the election. Does he have any evidence to back up his claim? Of course not. But that’s not stopping him from pressing on with his baseless lawsuit. And that’s not stopping his co-president Elon Musk for saying the 60 Minutes team deserves “a long prison sentence.” This is a page taken straight from an authoritarian playbook. By going after the media in this meritless suit, Trump has declared that the free and independent press are the enemy of the people. And he’s making one thing crystal clear: He plans to use his power as president to intimidate journalists and media organizations that publish facts and coverage he disagrees with. But this lawsuit is much bigger than CBS and 60 Minutes. Trump's actions directly infringe on First Amendment rights that protect the freedom of speech and press, which could have a chilling effect for those who report the news. We must come together to stop him from hijacking our democracy and our free press. [**We’ll explain more below on this coordinated effort by Trump to censor journalists, but if you agree that Paramount and CBS need to fight back, add your name right away.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tefbc2e97-841f-45b9-b999-254a9ba55893/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Just to paint the full picture: Trump’s suit against CBS isn’t his only suit against media organizations. ABC has already settled a $15 million suit, and Paramount, CBS’s parent company, could be next. They’re already signaling that they’re willing to settle despite Trump having dubious legal standing and zero evidence of wrongdoing. This has serious consequences not just for CBS and 60 Minutes but for all independent media in our country. If Trump is able to wield the power and influence of the presidency to silence media outlets, it will have a chilling effect on anyone who would consider reporting facts that the president doesn’t like. [**If we want to protect First Amendment rights and protect our democracy, we must show that we have strong grassroots support. Add your name to urge Paramount and CBS to fight Trump’s meritless lawsuit >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T44acfff2-f0b6-4849-ac54-d7a894c072ea/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Does he have any evidence to back up his claim? Of course not. But that’s not stopping him from pressing on with his baseless lawsuit. And that’s not stopping his co-president Elon Musk for saying the 60 Minutes team deserves “a long prison sentence.” This is a page taken straight from an authoritarian playbook. By going after the media in this meritless suit, Trump has declared that the free and independent press are the enemy of the people. And he’s making one thing crystal clear: He plans to use his power as president to intimidate journalists and media organizations that publish facts and coverage he disagrees with. But this lawsuit is much bigger than CBS and 60 Minutes. Trump's actions directly infringe on First Amendment rights that protect the freedom of speech and press, which could have a chilling effect for those who report the news. We must come together to stop him from hijacking our democracy and our free press. | | | | | | | Just to paint the full picture: Trump’s suit against CBS isn’t his only suit against media organizations. ABC has already settled a $15 million suit, and Paramount, CBS’s parent company, could be next. They’re already signaling that they’re willing to settle despite Trump having dubious legal standing and zero evidence of wrongdoing. This has serious consequences not just for CBS and 60 Minutes but for all independent media in our country. If Trump is able to wield the power and influence of the presidency to silence media outlets, it will have a chilling effect on anyone who would consider reporting facts that the president doesn’t like. | | | | | | | Thank you, Indivisible | | | | | | Other things you can do: Follow us on and * Follow Us | | | ---|---|--- | LeftAction Washington, District of Columbia info@leftaction.com | Having trouble viewing this email? | | | or

body:
MAGA’s War on Public Education: Slashing Jobs, Undermining Schools
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
Hello, friend! We’re excited to bring you _Across the Country_ , a newsletter from _No Dem Left Behind_ dedicated to breaking down the biggest issues shaping domestic politics. These aren’t just headlines—they’re policies and decisions that impact working families, wages, and the future of our democracy. My name is Zoltan Nemeth, and every Thursday, I’ll be bringing you the latest updates on the political and economic shifts affecting everyday Americans. From policy battles to grassroots movements, _Across the Country_ will keep you informed on what’s at stake—because when it comes to fighting for working people, knowledge is power.
---
| | | | **MAGA vs. Education**
---
|
---
The MAGA movement has never hidden its disdain for public education, and now, with Donald Trump leading the charge, they’ve officially started dismantling the Department of Education from the inside. According to _The Hill_ , Education Secretary Linda McMahon confirmed that the administration has begun mass layoffs as the first step toward shutting down the department altogether—one of Trump’s long-standing goals. This week, over 1,300 employees—nearly half of the department’s workforce—were abruptly terminated. McMahon framed the move as eliminating “bureaucratic bloat,” but the reality is far more sinister. This is not about improving education; it’s about gutting federal oversight, slashing funding, and weakening public schools to make way for a right-wing agenda that puts corporate interests and political ideology above students' needs.
### **What’s at Stake?**
Without the Department of Education, federal student aid, Pell Grants, and funding for special education programs would be thrown into chaos. Civil rights protections that prevent discrimination in schools could be weakened, and critical oversight of education standards would disappear. The Trump administration claims that these services will continue under different departments, but make no mistake—this is about stripping away federal responsibility for ensuring equal access to quality education. MAGA extremists have long argued that education should be left solely to the states, knowing full well that this would allow deep-red legislatures to push partisan, right-wing curriculum changes while gutting public schools in favor of private and religious institutions. Their real goal? To weaken teachers’ unions, eliminate discussions of race and history they find inconvenient, and replace fact-based learning with political propaganda.

### **The Bigger Picture**
This isn’t just about one department—it’s part of a broader MAGA strategy to dismantle the federal government, erode public trust in institutions, and hand control to their political allies. They’ve attacked public education for years, banning books, censoring teachers, and slashing school funding, all while pushing taxpayer dollars into private and religious schools. Now, they’re making their most aggressive move yet.

### **The Fight to Save Public Education**
The elimination of the Department of Education would require congressional approval, but Trump and his allies are already laying the groundwork. A MAGA-controlled Congress could rubber-stamp this plan if voters don’t stop them in November. Education advocates are preparing to challenge these attacks through legal action and civic engagement, but the fight cannot be won without public pressure. [**_No Dem Left Behind is committed to stopping the MAGA war on public education. The stakes couldn’t be higher—the future of our nation's education depends on protecting our schools from extremist attacks. If we don’t act now, we risk handing our education system over to those who want to rewrite history, defund public schools, and turn learning into a political weapon._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wrkp3-vlbmfz-kyd76rh5/) **Join us next week for the latest updates and stay informed with NDLB!**

The Texas Court of Criminal Appeals [blocked the execution](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOozAQhJ9m6UD22gZcuLjG3X_tlWjDbhJLDo7ACeHtT6T_q2k-zTeafz_TD6Wclttfekion2uZUKFrlWm1mZhSPibbcLgo9rqRoAerx970zjX3oHB2Yowj8b2M3trBycyzIJI1ZLlJ4SxTRhut3IB9J-QdOcELz_5iBwKrhFMta1fvUuVD2zUf5S1rN5dHk8O91ucG5g9gBIz7vnevjWphOk4AMG61rAdgXGTfzqCaygIYTy9gVAYwag0Ymd6J2yxloZXbvRRu5SPz6-Tbrxkwjohj771VagCMzRr4uaec09YPYNXtQSl_h9Vfn3oH_B8AAP___6ZpIg) of David Leonard Wood on Tuesday, despite repeatedly declining previous appeals. The 67-year-old Wood, convicted of the 1987 “Desert Killer” murders of six women and girls in El Paso, has long maintained his innocence, arguing that no DNA evidence links him to the crimes. Wood, who has been on death row [longer than any other inmate in Texas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGTgyAUBOBfgx0OIAgpKK6xy7VXOk_fM2GOiIMkmH9_Y_rrttj5Zmd_ruMVQgzr7Rse5MuxpFEJZbjouOxGhBDfo27QTwIvsiEvrZau73pjmrufpLPOLY6cRDeBmgAQzbIIKdSsrW2CPzHRyU4KY1XfElwMGFITzpdJW2BaEIaSclvuVOiAfYnv9KLczunRRH8vZdtZ98XUwNRQa22XdOiV6n4WmBrOyNSAtFMu_DfESJnTQfOzhLTyD8lh2wjizuf0zIUjvALySGmFjLymhE32uNUQY9h7y7S4PSDEz4Ly7yUvr_4CAAD__5tXZw8), was scheduled to die by lethal injection later today. A 2009 execution was stayed when Wood claimed he was intellectually disabled, but courts dismissed that argument in 2014. Wood’s 1992 conviction relied on testimony from a sex worker and two fellow inmates who [claimed he confessed to the killings](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuupDAQRL_GZD3yAzAEDjYhm003RA3dDNY2eGQ8r7-_YvIbV9VR6fy7jleMEvfbX9w4lPeSRqttA9qBcSNhlM9YVxQmTb2pOBhfm651bdNUa6C505619XpaOm-WmfTcmt5OxrFD3VcxnDDtjDO68ba9MPYNNmwnmvup9qhqzRRLypeycuE3Hot80pPzZU5bJWEt5X4o90fZQdlhTYkk7nyGyg4nW9lBO2WH7xbm9MgFVpRyAL95fpSYdkgLED4jgXDaMRO8UiIoKwOK8I0JiA_OBf5HEc5n3_SdBxa445Fge2TifCg7VDnQ_RVF4tF6VevbhlG-V8uv7p7B_gQAAP__q_FygQ), but Wood has argued the witnesses were paid or given reduced sentences to lie for the prosecution. He has asked the state to conduct further DNA testing of the evidence collected from the crime scene, a series of graves in the desert northeast of El Paso. Six of the nine justices ruled in favor of staying Wood’s execution “until further order of this court” [without offering an explanation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DuO7CAQheHV4AwLyq92QHATsr7phFbZVbSRsGlBTT92P-rJZwPfOfq_rssVY4rn7T8e7OQV8gIGBm06bbuFMKb30jfkVkOzbdjZqbeXsRuHodndBCYAX4Y14IbjeumnbSSY2YSReoTQRPfBTGc7a4YJxpZxHnBgWGmb135C1RumKLm0srPwC2tI7_zg0m75aJLbRe5Vdf8UeAWe0x1rPlCES21zuSnwnwEF3nQKvLUKPOEjkk6cTyyknzmTroJvnYPmF2_fEvOpz1xkZ6yiOekPqokrF9HEKHtV4Jvi6P6MKcU6Tqo3twNj-n0lf2Z6OPgJAAD__-m4a64) for their decision. The U.S. Supreme Court and Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals both denied requests to block Wood’s execution within the past month.

## Mammoth Tusk Discovered in West Texas
A [mammoth tusk was recently discovered](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAUhJ_GdCD_gH1duLgNXbbdEh3sQ7DWxgifhPD2q6TfdjSa-fR936YbxBS3-xdkdPRayiS5HFquWqGmADFdU98EN_NgRYNOmF7800oPQ7M6a2ZlrF40gLAeNKrZoO91sN4GIZcmuvcYV0IJPhipOwQ7wIByDt7OvQHWcwyRytHRioQvqEu6yhOPzpfcJLcS7ZWp_0yOTI7neXb5qrDBRmWL5V1ickxxwUpXQibH8qBQylGZHOGg6D8hvihuntoMORdaW3rUn_bz1h6w-bWVXArDter2dW8OF_YzphSrNqzn9wwxfXDoTz9PJ38DAAD__94aamY) at a West Texas ranch by a hunter searching for deer, marking the second-ever mammoth find in the Trans-Pecos. Ranch manager Will Juett initially [thought the fossil was a tree stump](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vwyAYhH8NbFjwYr4Ghi7Z0rWjRczrgArBsmmc_PsqUddup-ek56T7Ok_nkEu-XT9DRd8fS5uAg2JcMiGnGHJ5TiON_sKjExS9MKOwWmqlaPKL5kFzqZW00ajIAd0CDtCCBSuUodm_ZFwKKbgyoAcMTgWFcImzu4wmkJFjzL1tQ0_Y8RH2pTzbHbdhbpUWn3pfdyI_CJwInI7jGOa0tdurJXAqecEXziX-xbD1PJc3xL2zt5HVUGvrifWf_ZsBB6Gsc8OaVrr5uB65lLxrQ0Z-rSGX93L_94q7h98AAAD__3O4YEU) but contacted researchers at the Center for Big Bend Studies at Sul Ross State University in Alpine, who confirmed the “very rare” discovery. "_I figured it was likely just an old stump but imagined how great it would be if he was right_ ,” Juett said. “ _When they confirmed what they had uncovered, I couldn't believe it_.” Researchers spent two days [securing the tusk with plaster-covered burlap](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uwyAUxfGngQ2Lb8cDQxdv6drRuobrGAXsyNCQvH3l7J2P9Dv6_1ynK8QUt9s3ZHT1teyT5NIwrphQU4CY3pOmwc08DIKiE70WF6usMXR1fpDK-gu3JqAVc1gGvHCjQCDqxfdAozsxroQS3PTSdgiDAYNyDn6YdQ9Ecwyx7kdXV6z4grKk9_7Eo_N7psmttT4KUV9EjkSOrbXuXks-RyLHDVshcjzgQJYh572urP6WOwux-BPBwOLGGpbKPjaRIz1ceLSYUiy2J5rfMsT0Oav_1j-d_AsAAP__A9teZg) for safe transport to the university for further analysis. Carbon dating should provide an estimate of the tusk’s age in the coming months.

name: History Facts
subject: What's buried beneath the Easter Island heads?
body:
Adding to the rich legacy of Easter Island, archaeologists have uncovered full bodies underneath each structure.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1krv9cfc68dh1y5xfue2itzz8ww5s6hgh80hnl9x6ow1hprrgrn4cqyscqcqy8vsy2nmepky5zi3g0pxskqqli14yiq964b4oclntmyogw9hesgzn1lywfm9qf4ejj9oauzyypwatrmevkp3ovz4n8rtw&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st26t6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

# [The Easter Island “heads” have bodies buried in the ground.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st26t6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [World History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st26t6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st26t6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| A dding to the rich legacy of Easter Island, archaeologists have uncovered full [bodies](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st26t6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) underneath each structure. (But breathe easy: The bodies, like the heads, are made out of stone.) Known as _moai_ , the figures were built by the Indigenous Rapa Nui people between 1100 and 1600 CE, but as time took its toll, the statues’ lower halves became increasingly hidden by sediment and rock.
---
Located in the southeastern Pacific Ocean, Easter Island is one of the most isolated places in the world, and managed to escape colonization until the first European explorer arrived in 1722. The island itself was formed by three extinct volcanoes, which explains why the moai __ are carved from volcanic stone. The statues were built to temporarily contain the spirits of Rapa Nui chiefs, who were believed to become divine after death. The structures also sit on stone platforms called _ahu_ , and some moai are adorned with circular red stones (_pukao_)__ that sit on their heads and represent topknots of hair. Excavationists have also found cremated and buried human remains at some ahu, suggesting they were a place of Rapa Nui death rituals.
The moai __ bodies were initially discovered by archaeologists in 1914, and in 2010, the Easter Island Statue Project began excavating two of the bodies. Since Easter Island is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the moai are protected from humans, though the monoliths still battle erosion, rising sea levels, and the effects of forest fires.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st26t6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st26t6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## A new moai was discovered on Easter Island as recently as 2023.
For archaeologists, Easter Island is a gift that keeps giving. In [February 2023](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=st26t6&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), the dry lake of Rano Raraku (a volcanic crater) revealed a new moai — one smaller than most. The figure was uncovered by three Chilean scientific volunteers, who were working to restore the crater’s marshland. Experts estimate that the statue, which was found on its side gazing up at the sky, is at least 200 to 300 years old. The discovery is exciting for both historians and the Rapa Nui people, as it suggests there are even more moai to be found.

clean_body: Adding to the rich legacy of Easter Island, archaeologists have uncovered full bodies underneath each structure. | A dding to the rich legacy of Easter Island, archaeologists have uncovered full underneath each structure. (But breathe easy: The bodies, like the heads, are made out of stone.) Known as moai , the figures were built by the Indigenous Rapa Nui people between 1100 and 1600 CE, but as time took its toll, the statues’ lower halves became increasingly hidden by sediment and rock. Located in the southeastern Pacific Ocean, Easter Island is one of the most isolated places in the world, and managed to escape colonization until the first European explorer arrived in 1722. The island itself was formed by three extinct volcanoes, which explains why the moai are carved from volcanic stone. The statues were built to temporarily contain the spirits of Rapa Nui chiefs, who were believed to become divine after death. The structures also sit on stone platforms called ahu , and some moai are adorned with circular red stones (pukao) that sit on their heads and represent topknots of hair. Excavationists have also found cremated and buried human remains at some ahu, suggesting they were a place of Rapa Nui death rituals. The moai bodies were initially discovered by archaeologists in 1914, and in 2010, the Easter Island Statue Project began excavating two of the bodies. Since Easter Island is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the moai are protected from humans, though the monoliths still battle erosion, rising sea levels, and the effects of forest fires. | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . By the Numbers | | Height (in feet) of the largest discovered moai, “El Gigante” 69 | | Approximate number of complete moai on Easter Island 1,000 | Approximate number of complete moai on Easter Island 1,000 | | Percentage of Easter Island’s current population made up by Rapa Nui people 50% | | Weight (in tons) of the largest pukao 11 | Weight (in tons) of the largest pukao 11 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- A new moai was discovered on Easter Island as recently as 2023. For archaeologists, Easter Island is a gift that keeps giving. In , the dry lake of Rano Raraku (a volcanic crater) revealed a new moai — one smaller than most. The figure was uncovered by three Chilean scientific volunteers, who were working to restore the crater’s marshland. Experts estimate that the statue, which was found on its side gazing up at the sky, is at least 200 to 300 years old. The discovery is exciting for both historians and the Rapa Nui people, as it suggests there are even more moai to be found. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 3/13/2025
body:
House Democrats push “most outrageous” SB25-003 forward after 12-hour hearing
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,

What a night! 🎉 We officially opened our **Northeastern Colorado Regional Office** in Fort Morgan with an incredible turnout of grassroots conservatives, community leaders, and supporters. I had the honor of leading the ribbon-cutting, marking a major milestone in our mission to bring bold, unapologetic news to every corner of Colorado.

Thank you to everyone who came out to celebrate with us -- but especially to our RMV Ambassador Drake Hunter and his team for leading the effort in Fort Morgan! This expansion is just the beginning, and we’re excited to keep growing, keep reporting, and keep fighting for the truth. Stay tuned—big things are ahead for Rocky Mountain Voice! 🇺🇸
Here is a summary of today's top stories: ****
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** House Democrats advanced SB25-003 into the Finance Committee, one of the strictest semi-automatic firearm bans in the country, following a [12-hour hearing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Also, with rural infrastructure needs growing, Mesa County officials are advocating for a fair share of [state transportation dollars](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to ensure road maintenance and economic sustainability.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Homeowners in the Meadows Metro District say they’ve become an [ATM for bondholders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with little oversight or accountability, highlighting flaws in special district financing.

🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Senate Democrats, led by Chuck Schumer, plan to [block a GOP-led funding bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), making a partial government shutdown likely by Friday night. Meanwhile, the Department of Education has [cut staff by 50%](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as part of a broader effort to reduce bureaucracy and return education policy control to states.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** A new op-ed by Brian Joondeph criticizes Democratic lawmakers for standing in [support of Ukraine](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) while ignoring pressing domestic challenges.

This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, March 13, 2025. Don't forget to to listen to our new **Mountain Minute Podcast** , every morning! Click [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[House Democrats push “most outrageous” SB25-003 forward after 12-hour hearing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RMV STAFF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The sheriff in town may be tasked with the administrative burden of weighing in on your future firearm purchase, if Democrat lawmakers have their say. Although sheriffs from El Paso, Lake, Mesa and Weld counties testified that Senate Bill 25-003 is both unconstitutional and difficult to enforce, the House Judiciary Committee advanced the legislation after twelve hours of testimony.
The bill started as a full ban on manufacturing and selling semiautomatic guns but has since been watered down.
The latest version still imposes severe restrictions, requiring would-be buyers to navigate an onerous and bureaucratic process, including an additional background check, training requirements and even sheriff approval.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Mesa County Commissioner advocates for fair share of transportation dollars](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Mesa County Commissioner Bobbie Daniels is advocating for fair transportation funding, highlighting the growing disparity between rural and urban infrastructure investments.
* She pointed to issues like the closure of the Highway 50 bridge across Blue Mesa Reservoir, which disrupted commerce and essential services, emphasizing that rural roads serve all Coloradans, not just those living in remote areas.
* Daniels urged lawmakers to prioritize well-maintained roads that support businesses, tourism, and agriculture, warning that continued neglect of rural infrastructure could weaken Colorado’s economy.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Taxed and voiceless: How a debt trap turned Meadows Metro District residents into an ATM for bondholders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Homeowners in the Meadows Metro District of Castle Rock are paying for infrastructure bonds issued in 1989, with payments continuing for up to 100 years due to restructuring and negative amortization, despite the project’s original cost of $57 million.
* Real estate agent Jim Garcia uncovered that financial records between 1993 and 2009 were not publicly available, raising concerns about mismanagement and a system that keeps homeowners in perpetual debt while benefiting bondholders and developers.
* Residents attempting to gain representation on the district board have faced disqualifications and legal roadblocks. Despite efforts to reform the system, many homeowners remain locked into excessive tax obligations with limited recourse.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Joondeph: Democrats stand for Ukraine but sit for America](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [AMERICAN THINKER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Republicans hold only slim majorities in Congress, particularly in the House._
_Midterm elections typically shift control to the party not in the White House. Democrats need only a few more House seats to hinder President Trump’s final two years in office and will seek to impeach him daily until he leaves in January 2029._
_\Trump’s first month in office has been like a wrecking ball, disastrous for the entrenched ruling class and administrative state. The unavoidable chaos resulting from dismantling a massive bureaucracy, exacerbated by corporate media gaslighting, could tilt enough midterm votes to flip at least one house of Congress to the Democrats._

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Ruehmann: NGOs and PACs took Colorado—here’s how we take it back](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JAMES RUEHMANN | COMMENTARY | MARCH 11** _In the early 2000s, Colorado was a bastion of conservative governance, with a Republican majority steering state politics. But by 2012, Democrats had orchestrated a dramatic resurgence._ __
**[Anderson: SB25-003 faces Constitutional hurdles under the Bruen standard](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY PHILLIP ANDERSON | COMMENTARY | MARCH 11** _Many conservatives and Second Amendment advocates have raised concerns about the constitutionality of SB25-003, a bill that seeks to make it significantly more difficult for Coloradans to exercise their Second Amendment rights._
**[Walcher: Zombies That Can Never Be Killed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY GREG WALCHER****| COMMENTARY | MARCH 11** _In Haitian folklore a zombie is a dead body reanimated through Vodou magic. The modern concept of zombies as flesh-eating creatures from the cemetery evolved more recently, from the 1968 comedy/horror film, “Night of the Living Dead,” and sequels like “Dawn of the Dead,” “Day of the Dead,” and “Return of the Living Dead.”_ __

| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3398839/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Friend—

While Trump and Musk are taking a wrecking ball to our country, Republicans in Congress are refusing to do anything at all to intercede.

Instead, Republicans in the House just passed a funding deal that would allow Trump and Musk to do even more to gut and dismantle crucial programs—programs that help working families and lower energy costs.

**Now it’s up to Democrats in the Senate to stand up for Americans and say NO to any budget cuts that attack critical services.** |
[](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3398840/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Trump and Musk are attempting to destroy the constitutional system of checks and balances upon which our democracy depends. As I write this, they are shuttering entire federal agencies, blocking life-saving programs that Congress has already funded, and threatening to defy court orders. They are actively supporting the extreme MAGA budget proposal that would cut everything from Medicaid to climate and clean energy programs.

**But the Constitution is clear:** Congress has the power of the purse, not Trump, and not Musk. Democrats in the Senate **can _and must_** fight back to defend against these extreme cuts.

**We have less than two days to get through to the Senate and tell them that they have our support to fight back.**

[**Tell your Democratic Senators to take their power back and pass a budget without cutting essential programs.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3398841/87SdQ4wZ) |

| | How do some folks stay active well into their 70's, 80's, and even 90's... enjoying all kinds of activities like hiking, gardening, and golfing...

...while others find themselves hobbling down stairs... or needing to rock back and forth just to get out of a chair?

Well, according to a new breakthrough discovery by Harvard University, scientists now know it comes down to a single mistake...

A mistake, that... when avoided, not only reverses joint discomfort and everyday aches... but can actually make joints healthier than they've been in years.

And here's the best part: avoiding this mistake is easy. There's just one problem...

Doing this defies common sense. In fact, it's so counterintuitive, a recent survey found that up to 77% of folks with sore joints are making this mistake every day because they think it's helping. When, in fact, it does just the opposite.

That's why when they stop making this mistake, their recovery can be quite dramatic.

To date, more than 180,547 people have tried this with life-changing results...

Ordinary folks who were once couch-bound are now walking a few miles per day again...

Others have resumed exercise classes they were once forced to give up.

And some have even started long-distance jogging after decades of sitting on the sidelines...

A Boston medical doctor recently recorded a short presentation which shows you this [#1 mistake and why you should avoid it at all costs](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJyEkM2OmzAUhZ_G7ED4-g8WLDpN08VUWbSbdoUutgmesYHYnkTp01dEEVJXsz3-dL7ji2H1brx3RL0QgMmZRAAI-0IALn9uIX68hdfv5bfT73N5kacgtlf4-kSvsMOzxvnvy68fqv6gaT39TOZ8eb3SHc_31e7wU1rZgM5vqToUpmOjqXlhO6o4bRQIJYupUyM0rQTORm44b4ehBYG2phpVKzRvCtdBDaJmlFEGLYNKMGOolgopVQYtEl4_PBUGG51GmvINY1yWUOklFL6bcl7TY9iRwDFH1O_VZNHn6f62uDmjMxtJ4NhINthBiVI2NZa8QVEOVI6l1azRyhhqWkXYcfWobbBzJuyQcsTZhD4tfukxjC7u-n4bDYKAROMMYQcaXMr4bvvkKScg8yM1Llqdh_7zpv6_giJ2Zr05712SivD6_DjC9uVrB_8CAAD__yiwnfQ). His video quickly went viral, racking up more than seven million views. And thousands of folks around the country are singing the praises of this method across social media.

White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt **[snapped at an Associated Press reporter](https://substack.com/redirect/42de39db-ee0d-47ad-8930-37b9ff1a0396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for asking a question that crossed the line.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/42de39db-ee0d-47ad-8930-37b9ff1a0396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/42de39db-ee0d-47ad-8930-37b9ff1a0396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"(Trump) is proposing tax hikes in the form of tariffs," the AP reporter claimed as he began asking his question.
"Not true!" Leavitt interjected.
"I'm curious why he's prioritizing that over the tax cuts?" the reporter finished.
Leavitt answered, "He's actually not implementing tax hikes. **[Tariffs are a tax hike on foreign countries that again, have been ripping us off.](https://substack.com/redirect/42de39db-ee0d-47ad-8930-37b9ff1a0396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Tariffs are a tax cut for the American people and the President is a staunch advocate for tax cuts!"
The AP reporter pressed back, asking Leavitt if she has ever paid a tariff. "Have you ever paid a tariff, because I have! They don't get charged on foriegn companies, they get charged on the importers!"
Leavitt, frustrated by the reporter's tone, fired back, "When we have fair and balanced trade, which the American people have not seen in decades, revenues will stay here, wages will go up and our country will be made wealthy again!"
**["I think it's insulting that you're trying to test my knowledge of economics,](https://substack.com/redirect/42de39db-ee0d-47ad-8930-37b9ff1a0396?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**... I now regret giving the Associated Press a question!"

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2257%2E135344%2ExRhpmc)

We thought you might like a peek behind the scenes of what it takes to give a speech like the one Senator Slotkin gave last week. We only had one week to write and execute the live speech on CNN – so a lot went into it.
**First, the writing.** Elissa likes to work collaboratively. For big events – debates, speeches, etc. – she likes to prepare at home on her farm in Holly. For this speech, she spent the better part of the weekend editing and working through versions and drafts from her home.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar25.ecmY5i&refcode=em250313-1&t=2&akid=2257%2E135344%2ExRhpmc)
Meanwhile... the team was working on the set.
**Second, the set up.** We worked with a production crew to figure out the best lighting and backdrop for the shot. We didn’t want it to be complicated – the focus of the speech was what Elissa was saying and not what was happening behind her.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar25.ecmY5i&refcode=em250313-1&t=3&akid=2257%2E135344%2ExRhpmc)
**Third, rehearsals.** With something like this, practice really does make perfect. Words that feel totally normal on a page sometimes are hard to say out loud. We made cuts and changed words during the process of rehearsing the text in the time leading up to the live speech.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar25.ecmY5i&refcode=em250313-1&t=4&akid=2257%2E135344%2ExRhpmc)
**Fourth, show time.** At around 11:10 PM on Tuesday, it was show time.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar25.ecmY5i&refcode=em250313-1&t=5&akid=2257%2E135344%2ExRhpmc)
After the speech went off without a hitch, we broke down the set, cleaned everything up, and went to a local bar to celebrate.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar25.ecmY5i&refcode=em250313-1&t=6&akid=2257%2E135344%2ExRhpmc)
Moments like this are exhilarating and make us proud to work for Elissa.
Team Slotkin
[**P.S. If you enjoyed the speech, consider making a contribution to our campaign today!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar25.ecmY5i&refcode=em250313-1&t=7&akid=2257%2E135344%2ExRhpmc)

To help you learn more about Lewis, we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9052cba7ecfb423882725cfbd6d98fbc&_e=9qM3erSyTA7HRH7Td0sU3JUmCo-IbdNPUWY7nkgOCCYdHtmFfoX07GlwBIZXc_Qo_aNt0zE9DDm4FS9Q6bYb3I9gDOhuQrZlV7XPK9EOP0FnKIdneHDf7a7f23ExP835MoWdfhfM8RYJWNabZdsoX5AnjEoRzkOrstojpLNI6M3ql_gwrqo6gelNNIPc1toaZ2M4b-keoGiZR3KK9f7BUnvP70XG4tMFrAiONzG_8-GGKv3NZdnvxZVMYaR6tGXEasWDVowKMB2sr3FejD6xD4P_tTWsjUaGEB_8jm4NHs656OtgZyOQPHF8yk3ZW86o9QR7hSDgx_DjNSPJoNwN8ChZMv1SV9UA1CNKpmfKmYesaYA7jfGMDbsgxyaMMf7rj_15un-2mJAtcYewMua6ZPj0lfsnDBeBPk7AjzL2gKkMzkZgxhYpV_RfXqQ5iF91)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

The instructor, Dr. Michael Ward, is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

Derek,
I’m voting NO on the GOP billionaire giveaway bill coming to the Senate floor this week — because it’s a bad bill for the American economy and for American families.
Republicans may be calling this a funding bill, but let’s be clear: What it actually does is hand Trump a blank check to shut down whatever he wants, hurting everyday people in order to pay for tax breaks for the uber-rich.
Hell no!
The people of Virginia did not elect me to represent them in the U.S. Senate just for me to hand over a “yes” vote to a GOP majority that is essentially holding the federal government hostage to advance their agenda of slashing critical programs to pay for handouts to billionaires.
Democrats may be in the minority right now, but that doesn’t mean we get a pass when it comes to fighting back against the dangerous and extreme legislation the GOP is trying to push forward.
I will NOT vote for legislation that hurts our economy and gives even more unchecked power to Donald Trump.
As for what’s next — Republicans control all three branches of government right now, and they own the consequences of their actions. I urge my GOP colleagues in the strongest possible terms to work on a short-term spending bill ASAP that will keep the government open while the appropriations bill is negotiated into more acceptable terms.
I’ll keep you updated as we learn more.
-Tim Kaine

We are now suing the **City of Evanston, Illinois** , over its publicly funded "blacks only" reparations program, which we contend violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection under the law."

_And Judicial Watch is your best (some would say only) bet to get to truth and accountability on these and other critical issues_ ...because unlike President Trump, _we can and do_ use the courts to overcome Deep State delays and resistance!

[**But funding 160 active lawsuits (with more to come!), means we urgently need the active support and commitment of more dedicated conservatives like you!**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=72810&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

This is not a feel good story, but it does offer a meaningful solution to injustice.
Meta went from banning Trump in 2020 to donating $22M to his library in 2025. Now, they are actively restricting content opposing genocide and war crimes. Fortune [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/11016ccf-9491-44d2-8271-e9d4ebc41d25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "_Progressive Instagram accounts saw 65% less reach after Meta curbed political content_." This isn't the first time they've either blocked anti-genocide content or enabled pro-genocide content. Indeed, it was Facebook's enabling of violent content that enabled the Rohingya genocide, [a fact Facebook admits](https://substack.com/redirect/f75b8266-7167-4386-962e-52476e704a36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And now that they've turned off fact checking in the USA, they're putting Americans at risk. How do we best protect ourselves? **Let 's Address This.**
**More than 123,000 activists have subscribed to** _**Let 's Address This.** _**We are doing everything in our power to stave off fascism in the United States. Subscribe and join us.**
