## The Corporate Suppression of Truth
As a human rights lawyer, I've worked tirelessly to raise awareness about Trump's authoritarian policies, his corruption, his pardoning of insurrectionists, and his attacks on immigrants, reproductive rights, and democracy itself. But as I and others activists and lawyers have done our best to raise awareness of Trump's injustices, tech giants like Meta (Facebook/Instagram/Threads) are doing their best to de-platform and demonetize our content and advocacy.
Let me give you a real example:
One of my Instagram posts was demonetized and labeled a platform violation under "Objectionable Activity." What was the content in question? This:
> "The only real reason a President would pardon hundreds of violent, murderous insurrectionists--who killed police officers, injured hundreds more, and tried to kill the second and third in line to the Presidency--is in case he needed them to act again while again claiming plausible deniability."
What about this statement is false or objectionable? I cite proven behaviors of aspiring autocrats, who often incite violence. Again, this is not my opinion. A detailed study in 2020 by ABC found that [Donald Trump incited more than 54 documented acts of violence in just five years](https://substack.com/redirect/2cc704bd-565c-4b4d-8b73-d988edeafc9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That's more than all other then living Presidents combined--who by the way were found to have incited exactly zero acts of violence.
And Meta didn't just stop with censoring this one post of mine. Here's a snapshot of the dozens of videos and posts I've made on critical human rights issues that Meta continues to censor.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/15c07a00-524b-450f-85ab-2ed7f0d0f3a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Each of the above videos and posts on Meta discussed topics related to Trump's fascist executive orders, condemning tax cuts for billionaires as Americans starve, rejecting anti-immigrant propaganda, refuting myths about reproductive health, condemning genocide, and yes, even condemning insurrectionists.
Meta's response? Remove, de-platform, and demonetize. All to discourage activists from speaking up about these injustices. Well, I don't give up so easily, and this is why I ask for your partnership and your subscription to elevate our call and work for justice.
Let me offer what that looks like.
**If you 're finding value in this article and call for justice, please join our efforts as a free or paid subscriber.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..LXWZr347UMsS15nuZ7hH2AaluQwv9Y9TnnUPEJWlZ00?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=155931073)
## My Response to Corporate Suppression
The fact is, I don't share the above arbitrarily, I share it for three critical reasons.
One, as a living and breathing example of how lockstep the billionaire class is with Donald Trump. They will do everything in their power to protect him and his fascist ideals. The above receipts provide documented evidence of this collusion.
Two, this is why your support is so critical to help build platforms that will inform and demand accountability _independent_ of billionaire censorship. When I invite you to [subscribe to Let's Address This](https://substack.com/redirect/d2389159-dc57-4604-b4b0-ee953cfb72bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it is to help give voice to issues that tech giants and corporate media actively censor. We may not have their billions of dollars, but we can build a platform on the tenets of justice and factual accuracy. That is within our control, and that is empowering.
Three, because if we want a future committed to transparency and factual accuracy, then we need to invest in the orgs doing it right. [Ground News](https://substack.com/redirect/f23d5ad2-88b0-4ef7-bd30-bf032fa9a37b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is one such example.
## The Solution: New Media and Ground News
I've always said, I don't propose problems without offering solutions. This is not a moment to give up, but a moment to take action. We are not powerless against media manipulation. Rather, we have the ability to better control the information we consume, to identify bias, and to ensure that truth still matters--provided we take action.
That's why I use [Ground News](https://substack.com/redirect/f23d5ad2-88b0-4ef7-bd30-bf032fa9a37b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--one of the most powerful tools available today to combat media bias and misinformation.
[Subscribe to Ground News](https://substack.com/redirect/f23d5ad2-88b0-4ef7-bd30-bf032fa9a37b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## Why Ground News is Essential Right Now
Ground News isn't just another news aggregator--it's a game-changing tool that helps you analyze bias, track media ownership, and compare how different outlets cover the same story.
Here's what makes it indispensable:
✅ Bias Analysis: It categorizes news sources as left, right, or center and evaluates their reliability--giving you a clear picture of how biased or trustworthy an outlet is.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/741892e9-576d-4c27-87e0-d1c8f467fd7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
✅ Funding Clarity: It reveals who owns and funds each news source, exposing hidden agendas.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c1313f70-0b7b-4300-9f5e-bf527dd43b32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
✅ Transparency & Full Context: It compiles related articles on the same topic from different sources, allowing you to compare coverage and identify what's being emphasized, exaggerated, or omitted entirely.
✅ Blindspot Feed: It highlights stories that are underreported by left- or right-leaning media, helping you escape echo chambers and stay informed.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/58e8bdd8-65a7-4dfb-bebc-6cb3cbc6fb51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## Conclusion
Unlike billionaire-owned media giants, [Ground News ](https://substack.com/redirect/f23d5ad2-88b0-4ef7-bd30-bf032fa9a37b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)is subscriber-supported. That means it answers to readers, not corporate interests. Subscribe to Ground News through my link above and get 40% off their Vantage Plan--the same plan I personally use to research and write my articles.
Journalism and human rights should be based on truth. But unfortunately, we live in an era where truth is under attack. And while the corporate media apparatus has capitulated to billionaire oligarchs, we don't have to. Meta will likely continue to censor and demonetize and de-platform my content critical of Trump's corruption. But we have a choice. We can either sit back and let billionaire oligarchs control the narrative--or we can fight back with truth, transparency, and accountability.
I hope you join me in choosing the latter.

Subscribe and join us. | | ---|---|--- The Corporate Suppression of Truth As a human rights lawyer, I've worked tirelessly to raise awareness about Trump's authoritarian policies, his corruption, his pardoning of insurrectionists, and his attacks on immigrants, reproductive rights, and democracy itself. But as I and others activists and lawyers have done our best to raise awareness of Trump's injustices, tech giants like Meta (Facebook/Instagram/Threads) are doing their best to de-platform and demonetize our content and advocacy. Let me give you a real example: One of my Instagram posts was demonetized and labeled a platform violation under "Objectionable Activity." What was the content in question? This: "The only real reason a President would pardon hundreds of violent, murderous insurrectionists--who killed police officers, injured hundreds more, and tried to kill the second and third in line to the Presidency--is in case he needed them to act again while again claiming plausible deniability." What about this statement is false or objectionable? I cite proven behaviors of aspiring autocrats, who often incite violence. Again, this is not my opinion. A detailed study in 2020 by ABC found that . That's more than all other then living Presidents combined--who by the way were found to have incited exactly zero acts of violence. And Meta didn't just stop with censoring this one post of mine. Here's a snapshot of the dozens of videos and posts I've made on critical human rights issues that Meta continues to censor. | | ---|---|--- Each of the above videos and posts on Meta discussed topics related to Trump's fascist executive orders, condemning tax cuts for billionaires as Americans starve, rejecting anti-immigrant propaganda, refuting myths about reproductive health, condemning genocide, and yes, even condemning insurrectionists. Meta's response? Remove, de-platform, and demonetize. All to discourage activists from speaking up about these injustices. Well, I don't give up so easily, and this is why I ask for your partnership and your subscription to elevate our call and work for justice. Let me offer what that looks like. If you 're finding value in this article and call for justice, please join our efforts as a free or paid subscriber. One, as a living and breathing example of how lockstep the billionaire class is with Donald Trump. They will do everything in their power to protect him and his fascist ideals. The above receipts provide documented evidence of this collusion. Two, this is why your support is so critical to help build platforms that will inform and demand accountability independent of billionaire censorship. When I invite you to , it is to help give voice to issues that tech giants and corporate media actively censor. We may not have their billions of dollars, but we can build a platform on the tenets of justice and factual accuracy. That is within our control, and that is empowering. Three, because if we want a future committed to transparency and factual accuracy, then we need to invest in the orgs doing it right. is one such example. The Solution: New Media and Ground News I've always said, I don't propose problems without offering solutions. This is not a moment to give up, but a moment to take action. We are not powerless against media manipulation. Rather, we have the ability to better control the information we consume, to identify bias, and to ensure that truth still matters--provided we take action. UNDERSTANDING ABORTION:

Education, Healing, and the Power of Story

Mondays: April 7, 14, 21, 28

3pmPT/ 4pmMT/ 5pmCT/ 6pmET

Have you ever wondered about the stories you don’t hear when it comes to abortion?

In a world where abortion is often portrayed as a quick and simple decision, far too many women—and men—are left carrying silent
pain, trauma, and regret.

But what if the full story was brought into the light?
What if healing and hope were not only possible—but closer than you think?

We invite you to join Moms for America and Operation Outcry (a ministry of The Justice Foundation) for a special free 4-week
webinar series revealing the hidden impact of abortion through real testimonies, expert insights, and proven pathways to healing.

Each week, we’ll open the door to compassionate, honest conversations around:

🛑 The Reality of Abortion – The stories no one talks about, including men’s experiences and the documented trauma revealed by
research.

💊 The Rise of Chemical Abortion – What it is, how it works, and why it’s leaving women more vulnerable than ever.

💔 Healing and Recovery – Hopeful, practical steps that have helped women and men find true restoration.

🌱 Life After Abortion – How those affected are rebuilding, finding purpose, and making a difference.

Whether you're seeking answers, personal healing, or ways to better support others, this free series is designed to offer truth,
compassion, and empowerment—because no one should have to walk this journey alone.

🔥 Space is limited! Reserve your spot now and join us for this vital conversation. 🔥

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

The instructor, Dr. Michael Ward, is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

| Peter, Imagine a world with one less lemon candidate on the ballot. Where our general election ballots were full of trustworthy, anti-BS, pro-America, common sense candidates ready to disrupt the status quo in Trenton. President Trump said in his inaugural address that we are ushering in a “golden age” of the United States. I believe a “golden age” for our state is entirely possible too. A “Golden Age” in New Jersey might look like...
* Lower taxes -- and fewer taxes!
* First graders learning to read instead of learning pronouns and watching drag queens dance
* A return to academics
* Plastic straws in our drinks instead of soggy paper ones
* Less crime
* Fewer illegal migrant criminals
* Businesses starting and thriving
* The next generation staying in New Jersey
* More people moving in than moving out

This isn’t a far-off dream. I believe that this world is entirely possible. All it takes is for us to show up to the polls in June to make sure less “lemon” candidates show up on our ballots in November. You see, the elites in Trenton count on few people voting in the primaries–that way they can sneak in status-quo candidates who do their bidding. And it’s an easy gamble to make: historically, only 22 percent of common sense New Jersey voters vote in primary elections. That’s why we at the Common Sense Club started the One Less Lemon project. We’re getting out the vote for the June primaries. But we need your help to do it. **Will you give to One Less Lemon today and help us Usher in New Jersey’s golden age?**

subject: I’m sorry.

body:
| | | | |
---
Peter – I have spent some of the best years of my life fighting to save America from the radical left that wants to destroy it and sometimes, I’ve put that fight over the things I cherish the most.
I’ve missed birthdays, special occasions, and reunions...
I’ve come home completely exhausted from trying to secure victory in states far away from my home for **President Trump** and **our GOP majority**.
My dad served our country in the military, and he taught me how to love our country the way he does.
He still calls my mom his “bride” and I know that even when I don’t see him for months at a time, he understands the importance of **the work Early Vote Action does**.
My mom put everything she had into raising our family, and even today, she still puts everything she has into taking care of all of us.
I miss my family... body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This new segment dives into what you need to know about considering trade, college, and education opportunities.

PA State Senator **Joe Picozzi **and** ** Commonwealth Foundation Senior Fellow **Guy Ciarrocchi **share insights you don’t want to miss.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **PA State Senator Joe Picozzi **reflects on how the traditional college education path has overshadowed options for people to enter the trade industry and argues that "it is not just about equalizing [trade and education]; rather, we need to be glorify trades like becoming a police officer or first responder." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=dfe79ee49c&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Commonwealth Foundation Senior Fellow Guy Ciarrocchi** explains that high schools and the state should keep pushing policies of dual enrollment opportunities so that "high school students are encouraged to go do a shadowing experience, an internship, or to work in the summer." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ac9c6db050&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Voter Interests_
* Over the past 24 years, **293,000** students were unenrolled from public schools, and **153,000** were enrolled in charter schools. [[Commonwealth](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c5db745002&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* **20%** of PA's K–12 students receive special education services, and the demand for special education teachers exceeds the supply. [[Commonwealth](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3c18283eac&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* In 2024, PA education-related spending went up by $1 billion, with **$500 million** allocated to the poorest schools and **$500 million** allocated for special education, mental health, and physical safety in schools. [[S](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=38b45e639d&e=b7b3eddce2)[potlightPA](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d8d22ba6bf&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Education_
* In Gov. Shapiro's 25-26 Budget, the state proposed **$75 million** in basic education, **$40 million** for special education, and an additional **$536 million** for underfunded schools. [[WHYY](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0dc5b1e8b0&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Despite a decline in student enrollment, PA public schools increased teacher and administrator employment by **24,000** , a **10%** growth from 1999–2000 to 2023–24. [[Commonwealth](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a14fa7e44d&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Trade school enrollments grew**4.9%** from 2020-2023, while traditional higher education enrollments dropped by**0.6%**. [[BestColleges](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f53f255427&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **State Sen. Joe Picozzi on the Trades**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8a85c06e2b&e=b7b3eddce2 "What you need to know about PA’s Gen Z voters | Voices of Reason Ep. 12 – PA Sen. Joe Picozzi")
---
|
* * *
---
| **In Case You Missed It...**
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f7612cadeb&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9b51cde503&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c7806bc25a&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0fba883444&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4ae3d6cd92&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.
Visit the _Voice of Reason_ [YouTube page](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=df34779d43&e=b7b3eddce2) to experience all the great moments you missed.

---
| We like smart ideas and want to hear from you.

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=18058209299e4fe1b99b45d300a3e2d9&_e=UuOEl4h998cyaDjtsgJufI8W-4QYmh1fMSUbgMwBB-zrwnh3XH6D4KPVIyZsT6RjTSTCOs4x-G0MBe7WnwCovt7XbibN-QkOcbZzc0tF_mK7HJSBf0O6M9T9JQAlwOItQ6mwpIEC3RXI5UgNSDhIX6bsoiCywsNJPeZ6MbfnHd3-CIYTPL8TISyitm81Ehkz48vuJO2vJdSid96UqYis9Vk7PH53VrvBrqHJgro4RFzNV_rOMBlvn7WM2s_LR6XuMwmqKsKKvQZGb8iEIzeVfv9sbtTqM_lzRm1ZwAapuKCSFdSMN0UbQ6agPyylXpm2uYJbNiKLLPUNcqkQFDiEfUezpQ9ZItR36HBkiMhmbwV0zI17gGNloC7eCU1y5iqrLQ4pM6S97oWKlZzvhdI1f9bwO12iKFP9B0fi-zstsEQR267Zp7KB1qGzRkCXSLiMYtmKohhdWZXbI1hHOIUEVw%3D%3D)’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=18058209299e4fe1b99b45d300a3e2d9&_e=UuOEl4h998cyaDjtsgJufI8W-4QYmh1fMSUbgMwBB-zrwnh3XH6D4KPVIyZsT6RjTSTCOs4x-G0MBe7WnwCovt7XbibN-QkOcbZzc0tF_mK7HJSBf0O6M9T9JQAlwOItQ6mwpIEC3RXI5UgNSDhIX6bsoiCywsNJPeZ6MbfnHd3-CIYTPL8TISyitm81Ehkz48vuJO2vJdSid96UqYis9Vk7PH53VrvBrqHJgro4RFzNV_rOMBlvn7WM2s_LR6XuMwmqKsKKvQZGb8iEIzeVfv9sbtTqM_lzRm1ZwAapuKCSFdSMN0UbQ6agPyylXpm2vMHh1cSzb9XNSoNOhcxDgCMW3wNzbnytyJdgjYtSCK_0qZQjx4bZA_vSITBoYqtlRfwaQ2MUwd9rKhWl2OfFxec0YhKhoZa1anj7a8RqxmnC3gKX96Uay3ANiDTM2cvYwvRhdiYDj1eosEAv15S4rw%3D%3D) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

My situation is in your hands, Peter. I'm writing today to give you an update and to make a humble plea. _Look - this is from the bottom of my heart, so _please_ read this message to the end._ My team and I put together a historic win in 2021 to help flip all three of Virginia's highest offices red. Ever since becoming Lt. Governor, I've been logging big wins for my friends, neighbors, and every fellow Virginian. Now, I'm running for Governor so we can continue to keep up the amazing work we've been doing here in the Commonwealth and make history again. **But right now I have a few _SERIOUS_ challenges:**
---
**I was _legally_ barred from accepting even a dime in support of my campaign while I was in the Virginia legislative session.** But my Democrat opponent, Abigail Spanberger, was fundraising _**BIG TIME**_ while I was working hard in our capital. **Seriously** _**, a far-Left group injected $500K into Abigail Spanberger 's campaign coffers and there wasn't a thing I could do in response!**_
---
Now Spanberger has an _ENORMOUS_ fundraising advantage, Peter. Polls show this race is tied, but Spanberger has a serious cash advantage._If we don 't make up the difference, our conservative mission _will_ be cut short. _ **Today, I 'm making a plea to you as a Christian, a mother, and a Marine; _please send in any amount you can spare to support my campaign!_**

body:
https://www.cpr.org/2025/03/05/florida-man-in-prison-for-threatening-secretary-of-state-jena-griswold/ [https://www.cpr.org/2025/03/05/florida-man-in-prison-for-threatening-secretary-of-state-jena-griswold/]
Peter –
Last week, a federal judge in Florida sentenced a man to more than two years in prison for repeatedly threatening Jena and other public officials. This sentencing is a critical step in ensuring that those who attempt to intimidate election officials are held accountable.
The individual pleaded guilty to multiple counts of interstate transmission of threats after sending over 100 threatening messages to various public figures. Between April 2022 and April 2024, he targeted Secretary Griswold with violent, misogynistic threats related to her role in the legal battle over Donald Trump’s eligibility to be on Colorado’s primary ballot.
"Threats to try to intimidate election officials are unacceptable. It’s important that threats like these are taken seriously and that bad actors are charged for their actions."
Jena Griswold
Since the 2020 election, Jena has received thousands of violent threats. This case reinforces the importance of protecting elections officials who uphold the principles of our democracy.
Read more about the sentencing here. [https://www.cpr.org/2025/03/05/florida-man-in-prison-for-threatening-secretary-of-state-jena-griswold/]
Thanks for standing with us.
Team Griswold

subject: This is a bad deal.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
The House budget rips even more care away from Veterans by zeroing out the Toxic Exposures Fund starting Oct 1. Congress passed a bill and funded this program, and 2 million Veterans have had their claims approved. 2 million Veterans are depending on the VA to help them get treatment and care for diseases they contracted as a direct result of their time in service.
#
Peter:
If Elon Musk is already firing thousands of federal employees illegally, what assurance do we have that he’ll stop if we pass a budget?
If the Trump administration is sending entire independent agencies to the wood chipper, what assurance do we have that they’ll roll it back if we pass a budget?
If the VA is under direct attack — if services to Veterans are already being impacted, if Veterans are already going without resources they depend on, if experienced staff are already being pushed out the door — why would we pass a budget that does not demand the Trump administration fulfill their obligations?
If this alone was the state of negotiations on the federal budget it would be enough to demand the Trump administration to accept that Congress sets priorities and funding. They don’t get to choose what they fund, they don’t get to impound funds, and they certainly don’t get to fire anybody they want.
But it’s worse than that.
The House budget rips even more care away from Veterans by zeroing out the Toxic Exposures Fund starting October 1st. 2 million Veterans have had their claims approved thanks to this Fund. 2 million Veterans are depending on the VA to help them get treatment and care for diseases they contracted as a direct result of their time in service.
It’s worse than a bad deal. It’s a betrayal. We’re urging the Senate to reject the budget the House passed, and we’re asking you to join us.
[**Please, add your name and tell the Senate to reject the stopgap bill the House passed and demand a better deal.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/250313_vv_em_budget/?source=em250313-1-90&akid=34247%2E3013755%2E7-KOgh)

Here’s a snippet of Emily’s speech: _When I was seven years old, my sister Olivia was born with microcephaly. _ _What that means is that her brain was small and the doctors didn’t know why._ _They didn’t know if she would live, how long she would live, or what her life would look like._ _I grew up in a family of public servants. A bipartisan family. A biracial family. _ _My dad, who was a civilian employee of the Department of Defense, had pretty good government employee insurance — but that insurance would not have covered all of the surgeries, the specialists, or the equipment Olivia needed to thrive._ _But, gratefully for our family, the Washington State Legislature in 1993 voted to expand Medicaid, one of the first states in the country to lead that charge. And what that meant for us was that we didn’t have to worry about losing our house or what other bills that we would pay so that Olivia could survive and thrive._ There are millions of Americans with stories like this. clean_body: Emily spoke on the House floor about how Medicaid helped her family care for her sister, Olivia, who was born with complex medical needs: | Peter, Emily spoke on the House floor about how Medicaid helped her family care for her sister, Olivia, who was born with complex medical needs: Here’s a snippet of Emily’s speech: When I was seven years old, my sister Olivia was born with microcephaly. What that means is that her brain was small and the doctors didn’t know why. They didn’t know if she would live, how long she would live, or what her life would look like. I grew up in a family of public servants. A bipartisan family. A biracial family. My dad, who was a civilian employee of the Department of Defense, had pretty good government employee insurance — but that insurance would not have covered all of the surgeries, the specialists, or the equipment Olivia needed to thrive. But, gratefully for our family, the Washington State Legislature in 1993 voted to expand Medicaid, one of the first states in the country to lead that charge. And what that meant for us was that we didn’t have to worry about losing our house or what other bills that we would pay so that Olivia could survive and thrive. There are millions of Americans with stories like this. But Republicans in Congress want to gut Medicaid to pay for tax breaks for their billionaire donors. The more we share our stories, the more pressure will build on House Republicans to vote against these disgraceful cuts. We only need to peel off a few votes! We can’t allow this unconstitutional targeting based on political speech. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWMO7eLXQa64XgGggcQ0xmwBZKi3sT5d3pMT3vtKc1nJhTGX23JzH9mORHFPZh1f6meFAajrR8ImV73OuVTfTowcloK0ivxEdNMTDPxn47nGZ7TJvdPeCKijK8og6u7YzDT8eZCW6wkwiMBkC-wWmmZg/4er/V8x3DSsBSuClyVe1sU7jkQ/h0/h001.9FNG-sqlAew_H2SyDdpafl-5SHUFz5Ev9dXASXJn1s4)
---
Friend, Yesterday, a federal judge heard initial arguments in the case of Mahmoud Khalil, the Palestinian activist who was kidnapped by federal agents on Saturday. In a frightening escalation of the criminalization of dissent, ICE agents abducted him from his New York home, said they’d revoke his green card, and transferred him 1,300 miles away to an ICE facility in Louisiana—simply for peacefully expressing his political opinion. **Unfortunately, the federal judge overseeing this case didn’t take immediate action, and Mahmoud is still detained in Louisiana.** One of Mahmoud’s lawyers released statements from his wife, a U.S. citizen who is eight months pregnant, saying: _“For everyone reading this, I urge you to see Mahmoud through my eyes as a loving husband and the future father to our baby.”_ Mahmoud’s wife explained that she and him had just returned from an Iftar dinner on Saturday, breaking the day’s fast during this holy month of Ramadan. As they were entering their university-owned apartment, ICE agents pushed inside. She said:_“We were not shown any warrant and the ICE officers hung up the phone on our lawyer..._** _Within minutes, they had handcuffed Mahmoud, took him out into the street and forced him into an unmarked car. Watching this play out in front of me was traumatizing_** _.”_ **This is straight out of the fascist playbook, and it’s an illegal assault on our constitutional rights. Protesting genocide is not a crime.** We must continue speaking up and fighting back against this fascism. This is a test case and it couldn’t be more important we stop this and bring Mahmoud Khalil home. Mahmoud’s rights are our rights.**If the Trump administration can illegally abduct him and shred his legal rights, they will never stop.** Anyone this lawless administration disagrees with can be targeted. [**Add your name to join me and the 13 other Congresspeople who signed onto a letter demanding Mahmoud’s immediate release from Department of Homeland Security custody. We’re demanding his release, the reinstatement of his green card, and his swift return home to his family.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-lsKVGAu82BQ6Uuc0Uv5OJRsSmyDM1poHCrLJw2C5g707b5KJr8hb86hTHoNRHQdTxXyk2hT3D8VEpV5egrjd7qN-_LMX2GaeLNv58WozY4NhNoXmYnPGpaRrJo1eGIXBZg85nVtjNaxZYB-A0lBTXlWWztAMQ09jH_eUHdLRruXsVFGj29MzzaNk1l8OlPZ3tBIp1KFFOEYd-v3afLUf1gZRgqcDIrJxuI_CYEnMJU6mK76i91915cdxz4n61zUpJzOuyblzohNN4rDOon9aH-L_AMUGhzdG9HTTvRQqsvQ/4er/V8x3DSsBSuClyVe1sU7jkQ/h1/h001.HKYOs2Y4AHan1GeBzV_2AOjNYeNFVyMufpAIae4ifas) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-lsKVGAu82BQ6Uuc0Uv5OJRsSmyDM1poHCrLJw2C5g707b5KJr8hb86hTHoNRHQdTxXyk2hT3D8VEpV5egrjd7aqBj4EuXUQU9CKCm4akdzGg79KJdUO8RFrlxXg8XdxtqV_4GwWJ4b-j-WOEgHcgEBnqgCBDwasUhAtM7fNLALYC9xNhjO4awqLqYeqlB-_-sMni5inTcxT1lcyhtuJMqUHM_UHGyxnTOtDTc7zQFgFI41smV5BesPfetw1takYVUetm8s5i_nGeXbVXLspjgfI1qQrGzsx0JhFz3KBcERw/4er/V8x3DSsBSuClyVe1sU7jkQ/h2/h001.0JPVhNkA-pGrouEAy610z_5dv101J5aedVuCaliTY5Q)

In yesterday’s court hearing about Mahmoud Khalil’s detention, the federal judge extended his order to temporarily block Mahmoud’s deportation and ordered Mahmoud be allowed two private calls with his attorneys. He asked Mahmoud’s lawyers and lawyers from the Trump administration to submit letters with further plans this Friday.
Mahmoud’s attorneys want him transferred back to New York for immigration proceedings. One of his attorneys, Amy Greer, said: “He was chosen as an example to stifle entirely lawful dissent in violation of the First Amendment.” The American Civil Liberties Union is also joining his legal team, saying: “ICE unlawfully arrested and detained him in retaliation for his political views.”
**Mahmoud’s wife said in a statement** : _“Instead of putting together our nursery and washing baby clothes in anticipation of our first child, I am left sitting in our apartment, wondering when Mahmoud will get a chance to call me from a detention center._**_I demand the U.S. government release him, reinstate his green card, and bring him home.”_**
[**Will you add your name to lift up Mahmoud’s wife’s demands? Together we must pressure the Trump administration to release Mahmoud Khalil and refrain from further illegal arrests targeting political speech.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-lsKVGAu82BQ6Uuc0Uv5OJRsSmyDM1poHCrLJw2C5g707b5KJr8hb86hTHoNRHQdTxXyk2hT3D8VEpV5egrjd7KNEU2ExlU_e5Mfp8W2ltc1IqyjhUYHsWb25HaeICSa-fyfN4JIQRsx-Rdxzlz4oH8nS_PI9agnct5Q8moJQTk8KDwFogN4iKY81IA-gBwCy8-tmqjuQIeq0yi1quEUrNaDSE37-O9mBpHNO3O3iKzSzbztTLCnj5ouvqkPcAeaAsJ10wUTo295nWPQSoMiJVe5r9V56xUIMAW9wpEdXAcg/4er/V8x3DSsBSuClyVe1sU7jkQ/h3/h001.TvTTL6P6BJ890A1qusLvbYvHfg3yEbk5KeQqNOW8cHk)
Thank you for taking action, and please keep speaking up about this wherever you can. Together, we will continue resisting fascism and defending our rights.
With you in this fight,
Rashida

Friend,
I’m horrified by this weekend’s illegal abduction and detention of U.S. legal permanent resident Mahmoud Khalil. Without any warrants or charges, plainclothes immigration agents arrested him for exercising his First Amendment rights and participating in pro-Palestine student protests at Columbia University. Refusing to identify themselves, the agents even threatened to arrest his wife, a U.S. citizen who is eight months pregnant.
Federal agents first told Khalil that the State Department revoked his student visa. When they were told that he was actually a legal permanent resident with a green card, the agents were confused but then said the State Department “revoked that, too.” They hung up on Khalil’s attorney who demanded a warrant. Then the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) effectively disappeared Khalil for days, denying him access to legal counsel and to family visitation.
**These are illegal violations of Khalil’s constitutional rights to free speech and due process, and this is a threat to all Americans who engage in political protest.** Trump warned: “This is the first arrest of many to come,” saying he plans to imprison and deport more students involved in protests. We cannot be silent in the face of this lawless abuse of power. We cannot allow fascist targeting of people for expressing their political opinion.
**We must keep ramping up public pressure to release Mahmoud Khalil.** **A federal judge temporarily blocked Khalil’s deportation until a court hearing TODAY.**
**I led 13 of my colleagues in a letter demanding the Trump administration immediately release Khalil** —including Al Green, Jasmine Crockett, Nydia M. Valázquez, and more. **Will you join us?**

DHS only provided information about Khalil’s whereabouts after a New York court filed a legal petition to challenge his detention, revealing that DHS had transferred him over 1,300 miles from his home to an ICE facility in Louisiana. They have still not charged him with any crime. The American Civil Liberties Union has called these moves “unprecedented.”
Our Congressional letter not only demands Khalil’s immediate release, but also calls on the Department of Homeland Security to “immediately refrain from any further illegal arrests targeting constitutionally protected speech and activity.”
We will not let the Trump administration shred our constitutional rights to free speech and due process. The right to dissent is a foundation of democracy. Criminalizing protest is not only intended to silence the U.S. solidarity movement with Palestine, but is also a threat to all Americans who dare to speak out against our government.
Since last spring’s campus protests, when police arrested over 3,500 students across the country, universities have put in place new rules to suppress dissent, surveil students, and increase campus collaboration with law enforcement.
Now the new presidential administration could further endanger students with visas, the 13 million green card holders in our country, and even U.S. citizens. In a _New York Times_ article titled, “This is the greatest threat to free speech since the Red Scare,” Michelle Goldberg writes: "a government this willing to disregard the First Amendment is a danger to us all."
The article also quotes Margo Schlanger, a law professor who served in Obama’s administration as the DHS head of civil rights. Affirming that all people in this country have the same free speech protections as citizens, she said: “I teach constitutional law. And I’m freaking out.”
We must speak up—if Trump gets away with this, his administration will target more students, protesters, and people who disagree with him. We will resist this authoritarianism together.

clean_body: We can’t allow this unconstitutional targeting based on political speech. | | | Friend, Yesterday, a federal judge heard initial arguments in the case of Mahmoud Khalil, the Palestinian activist who was kidnapped by federal agents on Saturday. In a frightening escalation of the criminalization of dissent, ICE agents abducted him from his New York home, said they’d revoke his green card, and transferred him 1,300 miles away to an ICE facility in Louisiana—simply for peacefully expressing his political opinion. Unfortunately, the federal judge overseeing this case didn’t take immediate action, and Mahmoud is still detained in Louisiana. One of Mahmoud’s lawyers released statements from his wife, a U.S. citizen who is eight months pregnant, saying: “For everyone reading this, I urge you to see Mahmoud through my eyes as a loving husband and the future father to our baby.” Mahmoud’s wife explained that she and him had just returned from an Iftar dinner on Saturday, breaking the day’s fast during this holy month of Ramadan. As they were entering their university-owned apartment, ICE agents pushed inside. She said:“We were not shown any warrant and the ICE officers hung up the phone on our lawyer... Within minutes, they had handcuffed Mahmoud, took him out into the street and forced him into an unmarked car. Watching this play out in front of me was traumatizing .” This is straight out of the fascist playbook, and it’s an illegal assault on our constitutional rights. Protesting genocide is not a crime. We must continue speaking up and fighting back against this fascism. This is a test case and it couldn’t be more important we stop this and bring Mahmoud Khalil home. Mahmoud’s rights are our rights.If the Trump administration can illegally abduct him and shred his legal rights, they will never stop. Anyone this lawless administration disagrees with can be targeted. | In yesterday’s court hearing about Mahmoud Khalil’s detention, the federal judge extended his order to temporarily block Mahmoud’s deportation and ordered Mahmoud be allowed two private calls with his attorneys. He asked Mahmoud’s lawyers and lawyers from the Trump administration to submit letters with further plans this Friday. Mahmoud’s attorneys want him transferred back to New York for immigration proceedings. One of his attorneys, Amy Greer, said: “He was chosen as an example to stifle entirely lawful dissent in violation of the First Amendment.” The American Civil Liberties Union is also joining his legal team, saying: “ICE unlawfully arrested and detained him in retaliation for his political views.” Mahmoud’s wife said in a statement : “Instead of putting together our nursery and washing baby clothes in anticipation of our first child, I am left sitting in our apartment, wondering when Mahmoud will get a chance to call me from a detention center.I demand the U.S. government release him, reinstate his green card, and bring him home.” Thank you for taking action, and please keep speaking up about this wherever you can. Together, we will continue resisting fascism and defending our rights. With you in this fight, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Wed, Mar 12, 2025 Subject: Free Mahmoud Khalil To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, I’m horrified by this weekend’s illegal abduction and detention of U.S. legal permanent resident Mahmoud Khalil. Without any warrants or charges, plainclothes immigration agents arrested him for exercising his First Amendment rights and participating in pro-Palestine student protests at Columbia University. Refusing to identify themselves, the agents even threatened to arrest his wife, a U.S. citizen who is eight months pregnant. Federal agents first told Khalil that the State Department revoked his student visa. When they were told that he was actually a legal permanent resident with a green card, the agents were confused but then said the State Department “revoked that, too.” They hung up on Khalil’s attorney who demanded a warrant. Then the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) effectively disappeared Khalil for days, denying him access to legal counsel and to family visitation. These are illegal violations of Khalil’s constitutional rights to free speech and due process, and this is a threat to all Americans who engage in political protest. Trump warned: “This is the first arrest of many to come,” saying he plans to imprison and deport more students involved in protests. We cannot be silent in the face of this lawless abuse of power. We cannot allow fascist targeting of people for expressing their political opinion. We must keep ramping up public pressure to release Mahmoud Khalil. A federal judge temporarily blocked Khalil’s deportation until a court hearing TODAY. I led 13 of my colleagues in a letter demanding the Trump administration immediately release Khalil —including Al Green, Jasmine Crockett, Nydia M. Valázquez, and more. Will you join us? DHS only provided information about Khalil’s whereabouts after a New York court filed a legal petition to challenge his detention, revealing that DHS had transferred him over 1,300 miles from his home to an ICE facility in Louisiana. They have still not charged him with any crime. The American Civil Liberties Union has called these moves “unprecedented.” Our Congressional letter not only demands Khalil’s immediate release, but also calls on the Department of Homeland Security to “immediately refrain from any further illegal arrests targeting constitutionally protected speech and activity.” We will not let the Trump administration shred our constitutional rights to free speech and due process. The right to dissent is a foundation of democracy. Criminalizing protest is not only intended to silence the U.S. solidarity movement with Palestine, but is also a threat to all Americans who dare to speak out against our government. Since last spring’s campus protests, when police arrested over 3,500 students across the country, universities have put in place new rules to suppress dissent, surveil students, and increase campus collaboration with law enforcement. Now the new presidential administration could further endanger students with visas, the 13 million green card holders in our country, and even U.S. citizens. In a New York Times article titled, “This is the greatest threat to free speech since the Red Scare,” Michelle Goldberg writes: "a government this willing to disregard the First Amendment is a danger to us all." The article also quotes Margo Schlanger, a law professor who served in Obama’s administration as the DHS head of civil rights. Affirming that all people in this country have the same free speech protections as citizens, she said: “I teach constitutional law. And I’m freaking out.” We must speak up—if Trump gets away with this, his administration will target more students, protesters, and people who disagree with him. We will resist this authoritarianism together. Thank you for continuing to stand up for our rights and our shared humanity. Hey there, Peter — I wanted to let you know that **I voted no on the Republican continuing resolution.** This six-month continuing resolution would hand Donald Trump and Elon Musk the mechanisms they need to line their own pockets with _**your**_ hard-earned money. This budget guts funding for affordable housing, slashes veterans benefits, and sends more money to ICE to carry out deportations. Mike Johnson and Republicans in Congress are attempting to hand a blank check to the White House to let Elon Musk, an unelected billionaire, steal from the American people. It’s an endorsement to hand over the power of Congress to allow them to do what they want, from levying new tariffs to cutting social services. This CR isn’t about keeping the government open. We can craft a budget that doesn’t gut the critical programs people rely on and keeps the lights on. **I’m fighting for everyday people, and that means I’m ready and willing to pass a bipartisan, one-month CR that does not defund critical services.** **House Democrats are united on this front.** Thanks for taking a minute to read this, Yassamin | **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103796534/533278926/-1833725525?refcode=AU_YA_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20250313_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODliYTMyZC0zNDAwLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=z8h2jDYTa5mnPPMaCrgi7AeFWPNAhGtoN0ccnE4dRQg=)**

** 2024 was a busy time for our chapter's leadership. Chapter Chair Justin Paglino served as Field Director for Jill Stein 2024, ran for US Senate against Chris Murphy, and therefore unfortunately had no time left over to organize chapter meetings. The Green Party of CT was very active in obtaining ballot access for Jill Stein and had a presence throughout the state gathering signatures.

Now that we have recovered from a difficult year, we are ready to build at the grassroots level, to develop the presence and the power of our political party in greater New Haven.

We remain the only grassroots-powered party that stands for People, Planet, and Peace.

We hope you will come to our meeting as we reconnect with each other and make plans for 2025!

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103798897/533286505/397815234?amount=10&source=sbd_ad_em_fr_031125_years&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NzIyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMzNlNTA2Yi0zODAwLWYwMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bMLUWgr8_2CT8rxvCUoAtrijpzu-BqlL79WF5Yryn3E=) **Now:** We’re fighting against the Trump administration and FOR Pennsylvanians. name: Shelby Cole (via Democrats.org)
subject: I want to hear from you directly (seriously).
body:
---
Derek, I’m Shelby, the DNC’s chief mobilization officer. It’s my job to make sure our team is reaching people on the platforms where they’re spending their time; listening to our donors and supporters; and communicating what Democrats are doing on a daily basis. **That’s why I want to hear from you directly.** We want to know the priorities that matter most to you and where you believe the DNC should channel our efforts as we prepare for the fights this year, next year, and beyond. [Will you take a few minutes to share your thoughts through our feedback survey? (And please, be as honest as possible). Our team will analyze the responses and then provide a report to DNC Chair Ken Martin.](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/share-your-feedback-2025/?refcode=em_20250313_2956_fr&akid=2969%2E22930333%2EmTitON) **[SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/share-your-feedback-2025/?refcode=em_20250313_2956_fr&akid=2969%2E22930333%2EmTitON)** This isn’t one of those surveys where the hidden purpose is to get you to donate. We genuinely want to hear your feedback, and I hope you’ll take a minute or two to share it. Thank you for your time! Shelby Shelby Cole
Chief Mobilization Officer
Democratic National Committee

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

**$2.3B** to Somalia including **$200,000** for global warming prep **$3.7B** for Afghanistan including **$16** million to promote “positive masculinity”**$3.4B** to Yemen including for an “art exhibition” while our countries are at war**$700M** to Iraq including opening the first movie theater in Nineveh**$3.4B** to Syria including almost a million COVID masks**$1.1B** to Lebanon including or promoting “youth activism”
---

And that's just the beginning.And how did they get away with it _?_**_Because MASSIVE government unions have been protecting these bureaucrats from accountability..._** Friend, it’s time to take them down. These are the bureaucrats who’ve burrowed deep into the federal government (often they served as political appointees in a leftwing administration, but refuse to leave after that administration ends, becoming, instead, career “civil servants”).CIA. FBI. National Security Council. State Department. Pentagon. Hostile agents at the highest levels of these departments spent four years leaking, lying, and unleashing lawfare against the first Trump Administration.
---

* _Shouldn’t members of the executive branch work in good faith to advance the vision and policies of the head of the executive branch?_
* _Shouldn’t any bureaucrat who can’t respect the U.S. Constitution leave government service?_
* _Shouldn’t it be an enormous “red flag” that Kamala Harris won 93% of the vote in Washington DC and the fact that roughly 95% of campaign contributions by government bureaucrats go to Democrats?_

---

It’s bad enough you and I are being ripped off financially (covered in part one of your survey).But what’s worse is the reality that our votes and our constitutional republic are being ripped off and wholly undermined by these unions (part two of you survey). In short, this is an attack on the very foundations of our country. It’s part of the Marxist playbook that is destroying America.Today, I’m asking you to help the Freedom Center in exposing the threat posed by government unions to the mandate delivered by American voters in the 2024 election. **[**Your NATIONAL SURVEY ON ENDING GOVERNMENT UNIONS is the key to reaffirming this mandate by demonstrating the consensus that exists to remove the obstructionist deep-state.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=bfce52d41feb410ba6ea73aeb83800b0&_e=Jl6CmQtwlqdSOXvF2c-VtztV1PkAiaVGMzrE2eBdq6_ZybSqGDyyx0IgOY8j0MyRRT2RZt-ngLjkQ4-ct_ocPwRAJBj09RXBhxavU8scq2s1QVjYWvKX2USU8k70jWeDkwy6IVEUSbz6zFbiogaz-TNK1301m8kn2a__SZnBb4osi7juS3WYMU7Sfq4oFum8Y9iKX8fv1pEquTNS-K-_UilCKKnMFVh9pJUF1bDTSDXeMvURaxoUWIMFTfPhhG-yV33w1dEnl3xVRgIv68Z80Lh6E-qG_odNXxU7_t7K2QBEzoM7-1FI4uDZMXIKcDUn-AugwjGQlUYdo78QOkv8u9MaETNlcFNWljli89A85n1cpzdUILC-TOETXdhk0cMg0Aw9rvs8FZs8uC0n2TVthd9tFz7ao_y9aweJcNHAV7I%3D)** Please complete it as soon as possible. body:
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/70756F655332783372636F454353396562687376694F485948735343712B763672586D4157707A676459726C636F6733786F6E2B526572766D6752546567474F/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-01-10%20at%208.23.20%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Ron DeSantis is at it again— pushing a reckless plan that would abolish property taxes and leave Florida’s communities scrambling to survive.
At first glance, getting rid of property taxes might sound like a good deal, but let’s break it down: this is a ticking time bomb for homeowners, schools, and essential services. I need your help to stop this.
Property taxes are the backbone of Florida’s local funding. Without them, here’s what’s on the chopping block:
🧑🎓Public Schools – Our children’s education relies heavily on property taxes. This plan would leave local districts without the money needed to pay teachers, maintain school buildings, and provide quality education.
🧑🚒Firefighters & First Responders – Emergency services would face deep budget cuts, delaying response times when lives are on the line.
🧑🏭Infrastructure & Roads – From fixing potholes to maintaining bridges, property taxes keep our communities running. Without them, Florida’s roads and public spaces will fall into disrepair.
🧑🔧Higher Costs for Renters & Small Businesses – With local governments desperate for revenue, the burden will shift to higher sales taxes, fees, and other unpredictable costs, squeezing small businesses and working families.
Who Benefits? Big developers and out-of-state investors stand to profit the most , while everyday Floridians will bear the brunt of the fallout.
This isn’t tax relief—it’s a tax shell game that puts all of us at risk.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/6D386733746D78644D73776749674D5643436846466139627775775336356B6C6D74706E5A594C747370484D6E73584F6D432F2B6C323869777431766A373746/editor_images/Screenshot%202025-03-13%20at%202.41.34%E2%80%AFPM.png]
As your representative, I will fight for responsible tax policies that keep our communities strong. We need fair and sustainable revenue sources that protect Florida’s families without gutting essential services. We only have 19 days until the moment of truth arrives: special elections.
We cannot let DeSantis and his allies sell Florida’s future to the highest bidder. Chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can today to help us push back against this dangerous agenda and keep Florida livable for all. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gay2025klemail]

| Here’s more about why I’m in this race: We outperformed every Democratic race in our district in 2024, reaching more than five points better than the top of the ticket, and even outperforming the winning Senate race.

We did it with a coalition that united working Wisconsinites, ranging from labor unions, to farmers, to students, and even voters who went with Trump. And since that time, our call to put real, working class Wisconsinites first has only become more critical. These past couple of months have the American people reeling from crushing attacks from this administration – policies that have put billionaires first and hit working families the hardest. I’m feeling it personally. I’m still waitressing at the Good Wives in Eau Claire, and I hear the same ongoing concerns from folks in our community. Basic costs of living like groceries and utility costs are still on the rise, health care is less accessible and affordable, family farms are folding, and home ownership feels further and further out of reach. We can’t sit on the sidelines as the elites take up every last resource and leave all of us behind. We need action to have public service that works for us. I know what working families need, because I’m part of one. And I wouldn’t be in this race if I wasn’t confident we could finish the job. But I can’t do this alone: [Split a donation of $10 with Blue Amp Action today to become a Founding Donor of my campaign. Hi Peter,
I’m Joe Kerr, a second-generation firefighter and labor leader. For three decades, I’ve run headfirst toward the problem—whether inside burning buildings or in the halls of the State Assembly, I’ve always fought for common-sense solutions to save lives.
**[Now, I need your help keeping up the fight as I run for Congress to represent California’s 40th District. This is going to be a team effort, so Peter, will you split a contribution between State Democrats Committee and my campaign today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/86961?firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8818%2E614464%2EM6qKJD)**
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/86961?firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8818%2E614464%2EM6qKJD)**
In firefighting, when we pull up on a scene of a house on fire, we don’t ask who they voted for—we just put out the fire. As a fire captain and labor leader, I worked with both parties to protect rights and save lives. _It’s common sense._
**So, when I see Trump’s White House merely suggest seeking retribution for his political rivals instead of getting to work on the things he was elected to do, like lowering the costs of groceries and healthcare, I can’t sit back and let the fire spread.**
I will work with whoever, whenever, wherever, to fix our community’s greatest problems. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Some Senate Democrats, including Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, recently
joined Republicans in passing a bill that’s a massive giveaway to the
cryptocurrency industry.

This bill would hugely deregulate crypto – repealing a rule that required
Crypto firms to report customer transactions to the IRS and was estimated
to bring nearly $4 billion in revenue to the government from Crypto
corporations. One tax expert even noted: “It would encourage more of the
[Crypto] industry to move into the shadows, making it more difficult to
counter crimes ranging from tax evasion to fentanyl trafficking to
terrorist financing.”.

Simply put, when enacted, it will open the floodgates for even more
widespread fraud and even less oversight to boost corporate profits and
make crypto billionaires even richer.

Democrats (including Chuck Schumer.....) joined Republicans in voting to
repeal a Biden rule requiring cryptocurrency brokers to adhere to the same
tax reporting rules as stock brokers.' Justice Democrats repost says:
'Crypto Super PACs spent $131 million in Congressional elections last
year. Looks like that buys you at least 70 bipartisan Senate votes in
favor of tax evasion & corporate fraud.'

year, they were able to buy the votes of 70 senators, including 19

The Crypto industry is an existential threat to our economy and democracy.

We must primary these out-of-touch Democrats with candidates who will put
the needs of struggling Americans first. Our leaders must prioritize
things like Medicare for All, housing as a human right, and raising taxes
on billionaires & corporations instead of stripping away regulations that
prevent the rich from ripping us off.

name: Andy Beshear
subject: Party loyalty over people – who does that serve?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
We need real leadership. Here’s how we get it.
I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again: too many of our elected "leaders" are more focused on party loyalty than on delivering for the people they were elected to serve.

**That’s exactly why we launched In This Together PAC.**

We saw firsthand how the path to electing good, for-the-people leaders is to put aside political gamesmanship and focus every day on improving people’s lives – _not just in Kentucky, but across the country_.

Too many politicians are more interested in scoring political points or fueling division. When I ran for governor, I refused to play their game. I didn’t give in to anger politics. And I didn’t take the bait when my opponents tried to drag me into pointless, divisive debates.

Instead, I focused on what mattered most: fighting for good schools, good jobs, and good healthcare for Kentuckians. And we won – _twice_. We proved that when we put commonsense solutions over partisanship, we can win. When we focus on results over rhetoric, we can move our communities forward. And that’s exactly what ITT PAC is fighting for: leaders who care about service over spectacle and people over party.

We know what works. We know what’s possible. But we can’t do this alone. We are officially in the final stretch with less than THREE WEEKS until Election Day.
That means we have only a short window of time to flip this seat, send a Democrat to Congress, and take a critical step toward ending MAGA control.
This is our chance to change the course of our country, but we cannot take anything for granted.
We have a real opportunity to win, but the truth is that it will take an enormous effort in these final weeks to push us over the finish line. We can flip this seat, but it will not happen unless we reach every last undecided voter and make sure our supporters turn out to cast their ballots.

The conversations we have in the next three weeks could make the difference in this race.

I know it can feel like we are in a dark time right now. But as long as I am in this office, I will continue to be there for the people of Maryland. I ran for governor because I believe no one should be left behind. It is at the heart of our agenda. Our proposed budget will make taxes fairer for nearly two-thirds of Marylanders, support small businesses and create more jobs, and lift thousands of children out of poverty in our state. We’re standing up to the instability in Washington, D.C. to bring more relief to Marylanders, not more hardships. Fellow American,
---
During President Trump’s joint address to Congress, he told the country, _“My fellow citizens, America is back.”_
---
Those words – and the strength of President Trump’s inspiring leadership – have already begun to right the ship for our country in what feels like the blink of an eye.
---
_But today, sadly, I’m reaching out for a far more somber reason._
---
**I’ve written this letter with a heavy heart, but I hope you’ll find it in __YOUR__ heart to read it in its entirety because every word is God’s honest truth.**
---
**While our beautiful country may have emerged from four long years of darkness, tyranny, and the Left’s weaponized justice system, my journey out of that darkness is __NOT__ yet finished.**
---
**If the Democrat Attorney General in Arizona gets her way, I’ll be in a jail cell until I’m 100 years old!**
---
And worst of all, these Deep State goons truly believe I’m finished, just like the media says, all because this case that’s already set to go to trial was brought on bogus _state-level_ charges that PREVENT President Trump from saving me with a federal pardon.
---

Peter, let me take you on a tour of Monte Rio Redwoods.

clean_body: Explore the magical Monte Rio Redwoods Peter, let me take you on a tour of Monte Rio Redwoods. I’ve had the privilege of visiting this stunning site many times. It takes my breath away each time I visit. Monte Rio Redwoods is an outdoor enthusiast’s dream, a haven for wildlife, and its fog-shrouded forests have an ancient, almost mystical quality. Why tell you how amazing this property is when I could just show you with some pictures? Photo by Max Whittaker Here, a few old-growth giants still stand tall, side-by-side with large second-growth trees and a plethora of carbon-hungry, younger redwoods. This is a forest set to thrive in the years to come – . Photo by Justin Lewis These rolling hills provide breathtaking views that stretch toward the horizon. Looking out you can catch a glimpse of the winding Russian River, and the expanse of the Pacific Ocean in the distance. Creeks run to the river; forest gives way to open meadows – everything within these lands is connected. A connected landscape is a resilient one. Conserving Monte Rio Redwoods will mean filling in the missing piece of a contiguous redwoods landscape. Photo by Max Whittaker This land is brimming with life. Fern-lined streams flow; mountain lions, California quail, and Sonoma tree voles coexist; and towering redwoods stand like silent sentinels in this diverse habitat. Photo by Justin Lewis Thank you for supporting Monte Rio Redwoods! | Sara Press Senior Manager of Land Protection ---|--- P.S. This visit to Monte Rio Redwoods was virtual, but if we can acquire and conserve this property, it will provide more parklands and recreation opportunities for locals and visitors alike! body:
Our constituents shouldn’t have to suffer because Republicans want to act like children.
Hi Derek, it’s Congresswoman Sarah McBride. John said I could reach out because you have what it takes to stand up in critical moments — and this is one of them.
**Yet another GOP politician decided to get his own 15 Minutes of Twitter Fame at my expense.**
At a subcommittee hearing, the Republican chairman referred to me as “Mr. McBride.” And when Rep. Bill Keating defended me, the chair _adjourned the hearing_ to avoid acknowledging his own immaturity.
**Republicans are a bunch of overgrown schoolyard bullies.**
Our constituents shouldn’t have to suffer because Republicans want to act like children. **This pettiness needs to end.** I was there ready to ask questions on nuclear non-proliferation and US support for our democratic allies in Europe.
**I ran for Congress to roll up my sleeves and do the job.** No matter what they throw at me, I’m 100% focused on delivering for Delawareans. And if that means listening to their childish insults, _so be it._
[**Derek, I’m proud to have John’s support at this moment, but we need you with us. Can you split an urgent $5 contribution to help us cut through the noise and keep up the fight for all of us?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20250313?refcode=em20250313-9986&refcode2=9986_434096_YSfPIk&akid=9986%2E434096%2EYSfPIk)

body:
https://www.lateefahsimon.com [https://www.lateefahsimon.com]
Friend,
As I reflect on my journey, I am reminded of why I ran for office and who I am fighting for: the single working women and mothers in the Bay Area, just like my mother and me.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250313_workingmomsday_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250313_workingmomsday_actrs]
I was raised by a single mother in San Francisco’s Western Addition neighborhood. Then, at 18, I became a young single mother myself. I quickly learned that the government doesn’t always work for families like mine.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250313_workingmomsday_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250313_workingmomsday_actrs] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250313_workingmomsday_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250313_workingmomsday_actrs]
Often, I had to bring my daughter to class due to lack of childcare, a struggle many single mothers face daily. Being a single mother meant I had to work twice as hard to give my daughter the same opportunities as her peers.
Right now, Republicans are actively working to gut the very programs that working moms depend on —childcare assistance, paid family leave, and affordable healthcare, just to name a few. They want to make it even harder for moms to provide for their families, all while handing tax breaks to billionaires. I refuse to let that happen.
Cause let’s face it: Donald Trump isn’t working for my mother, and he’s not working for yours either.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250313_workingmomsday_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250313_workingmomsday_actrs]
That’s why I’ve spent 25 years fighting for women like us—organizing, advocating, and ensuring our voices are heard. Today, I live with my youngest daughter while my eldest just graduated from law school. My journey has been challenging but powerful, and it has only strengthened my resolve to fight for justice.
Parents deserve someone in Congress who knows what it’s like to sprint from the end of a shift to the pickup line, or to answer emails while making tomorrow’s PB&J. While parents fight for their kids every day, I’ll be fighting for parents—I’ll be fighting for the working mothers.
In honor of working mothers everywhere, will you stand with me? Every contribution helps us build a movement for real change. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=x_250313_workingmomsday_actrs]

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39535%2E3422442%2EcxGIR5)
Derek,
I’m running for California Governor, because I’m not going to stay silent while Donald Trump threatens our rights and destabilizes our economy.
**I'm fighting for the future all of our kids deserve:**
* Bringing down health care costs, so that getting sick doesn't mean a lifetime of financial harm.
* Building more housing for all income levels, so that people can afford to live, work, and raise a family here.
* Combating the climate crisis, so that we can prevent wildfires from getting even more frequent and devastating.

On every one of these issues and more, Trump is moving us in the exact wrong direction. He’s supported slashing Medicaid and Medicare in the federal budget. His tariffs will make it more expensive and difficult to build housing. He’s politicized disaster relief and proposed undoing the progress we’ve made on climate action.
Our leaders need to be clear-eyed about the threat Trump poses to our country. **We also have to be specific in explaining to people what the harm is.**
In Congress, I used my platform (and on occasion, my whiteboard) to break down for people exactly how Donald Trump was ripping us off.
**In this moment, we could use a whole lot more of that clarity.**
**[Will you chip in $5 to help elect me as governor, so I can continue holding the Trump Administration’s feet to the fire?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250313_3_ak?refcode=em20250313-39535&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39535_3422442_cxGIR5&akid=39535%2E3422442%2EcxGIR5)**

Thanks for considering,
Katie

We have an update, Peter — This week, House Republicans passed a continuing resolution that cedes
congressional power to Trump and Musk as part of their plan to fund the
government. The continuing resolution allows extreme funding cuts that will
deepen the harm and chaos that Trump and Musk have already created as people
across the country lose jobs, contracts are cancelled, and critical services and
protections are gutted. Now the Trump Slush Fund bill has moved to the Senate, and the vote could happen
at any moment. Senators need to hear from YOU. Sign your name and urge your Senators to reject this extreme partisan funding bill that President Trump and Elon Musk will treat as a slush fund to enable and entrench their harmful agenda. https://links.messages.lcv. Together, we can stop this poisonous funding bill from becoming law. Thanks for
being with us. Chris, Annie, Shae, Alex, and Kelly
LCV Rapid Response Team We’re running out of time, Peter. Government funding runs out at the end of this week, and if a deal isn’t reached by then, the federal
government will shut down.MAGA extremists want a funding patch that allows Donald Trump and Elon Musk to
illegally gut even MORE federal government programs that help working families
and lower energy costs. This is wildly out of touch. American families are already struggling with rising energy costs.MAGA funding cuts degrade our air and water quality, raise energy costs, kill
millions of good paying jobs, and threaten the health and safety of families
across the country — just to give billionaires more tax breaks. There is still time to pressure Congress before a government shutdown, Peter. Take action today and tell your member of Congress: NO cuts in the budget to critical services to appease Trump and Musk. https://links.messages.lcv. On their wishlist for this budget, Trump, Musk, and Republicans want to halt
clean energy investments that would lower costs and produce more clean energy
here in the United States. We can’t afford to let them put our economy and our
future at risk. Our families deserve clean air and water. The profits of billionaires and corporations shouldn’t take priority over our
health. The Constitution is clear: Congress — not the president, and certainly not the
unelected Musk — holds the power of the purse. They can stop these illegal
overreaches and defend against these extreme cuts. But to make it happen, we
need to make our voices heard. Without action by Congress, the government will shut down on Friday, %%FIRST

"**Sylvester Turner carried into Texas Capitol to lie in state** ," Houston Chronicle's **Taylor Goldenstein and Isaac Yu** -- "State lawmakers on Thursday formally honored **Sylvester Turner** , adding to the parade of tributes that have poured out since his death last week and ahead of his memorial on Saturday in Houston.

Turner, who died last Wednesday at age 70, was brought to the state Capitol shortly before noon and was set to lie in state in the House chamber through Friday.

In a memorial resolution Thursday morning, several House members spoke about Turner's life and legacy. The Houston native had served as a state House member for over two decades before becoming the city's mayor and, most recently, a U.S. representative for the 18th Congressional District. State Rep. **Senfronia Thompson** , a Houston Democrat and Turner's longtime colleague, introduced the resolution.

State Rep. **Christian Manuel** , D-Beaumont, recalled that when he was 19 and one of few Black staffers at the state capitol, Turner always remembered his name and provided mentorship. Manuel said Turner taught him to work across the aisle for the common good.

"That's who he was, a person who cared for people, a person who strived to make this legislature better together regardless of whether there was an R or a D or an I in front of your name," Manuel said.

**Editorial: "Will Texas finally make it harder for violent people to bond out of jail?**" via Dallas Morning News**** -- "A recurring complaint we hear from police in Dallas is that they arrest dangerous people [only to see them released from jail](https://substack.com/redirect/54c29ac1-415e-4e67-9bf7-1f4e383bc45d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) days or weeks later. Officers gripe about judges who set low bail amounts and prosecutors who don't challenge them. [Too many people](https://substack.com/redirect/ae3685c1-ed5f-424e-9967-3498326f9fcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [have lost loved ones](https://substack.com/redirect/185fe004-c004-44f3-b3de-d0dc98febec7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or been subjected to assault at the hands of people out on bail who shouldn't have been.

No doubt that [the cash bail system in this state](https://substack.com/redirect/e8dcd099-ec97-44ea-aa6c-796aeb469c41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has often been too lenient to people accused of serious crimes. Yes, some judges set absurdly low bail amounts for the offense, but it's also true that certain suspects have the wealth or personal connections to post high bail amounts. And there have been cases where judges set million-dollar bail amounts for violent crimes and drew lawsuits. At the root of the problem is the way the system is designed in Texas.

Under the state Constitution, judges cannot deny bail to people accused of violent felonies except in really extreme and narrow circumstances. It is also typical that the officials setting original bail amounts are not the elected state district judges who will hear the criminal cases and who answer to voters. In fact, bail decisions are usually made by appointed magistrate judges at the county level or municipal judges who consider release conditions for suspects first booked in city jails.

This is why we support two bills from the Texas Senate that would reform the bail system in Texas to protect the public.

Senate Joint Resolution 5 would allow judges to deny bail to people accused of first-degree sexual felonies, serious violent crimes like murder and aggravated assault, or human trafficking. The bill specifies that judges must consider whether there is "clear and convincing evidence" that bail is insufficient to ensure the safety of the community or that the suspect returns to court. A judge who denies bail must issue a written report explaining his or her decision.

If the Legislature approves SJR 5, the proposed constitutional amendment will go to voters for approval.

The other legislation, Senate Bill 9, would correct a recurring issue in Dallas County and other big counties. Dallas County Assistant District Attorney **Kim Nesbitt** told lawmakers that a long-ago court ruling determined that the judge who originally set the bail (usually a magistrate judge) retains jurisdiction over the bail amount until the suspect is formally charged. In felony cases, that means that district judges can't raise or modify bail amounts, even at the request of prosecutors, until there is an indictment by a grand jury, which can take weeks or months. SB 9 addresses this problem by authorizing district judges to review requests to change bail amounts for felony suspects before a case is formally charged.

The bill would also allow judges to deny personal bonds -- release conditions with no financial requirements -- to people accused of violating family violence and sexual abuse court orders, terroristic threats and murder as a result of dealing fentanyl.

We commend Dallas County District Attorney **John Creuzot** for publicly supporting these measures. We hope his stance will nudge reluctant Democrats in the Texas House to get behind these bills."
